We welcome diverse perspectives and foster an environment of collaboration and service. P
items.description: Donor Network West’s mission is to save and heal lives through organ and tissue donation for transplantation and research. At Donor Network West, we’re looking for people who embody our core values: passion, excellence, equity and inclusion, and relationships. We welcome diverse perspectives and foster an environment of collaboration and service. POSITION SUMMARY The Senior Cloud & Identity Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for the design, operation, automation, and security of DNWest’s cloud and identity platforms, with primary focus on Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra (Azure AD), Intune, and the supporting public key, authentication, and access-control infrastructure. This role owns the day-to-day engineering and continuous modernization of DNWest’s identity-centric security posture, drives DevOps practices across the organization, and develops automation and tooling that reduce manual operations across the IT department. The role partners with the Manager of Information Technology on architecture, change management, and compliance. ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES The essential functions and qualifications listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification and general qualifications required. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, responsibilities and qualifications. Employees may perform other duties as assigned. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Operational Management Microsoft 365 and Cloud Services Engineer, operate, and modernize DNWest’s Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Purview, Intune, and Defender XDR. Design and maintain integrations between M365 and line-of-business systems using Graph API, service principals, and managed identities. Own cloud workload design and operations in Microsoft Azure and supporting SaaS platforms, including subscription/tenant governance, cost management, and capacity planning. Maintain a documented cloud architecture, service catalog, and shared-responsibility model for all cloud services in use. Entra ID and Identity Security Serve as the technical owner of Microsoft Entra ID, including directory hygiene, hybrid sync, lifecycle workflows, and B2B/external collaboration controls. Design, implement, and continuously tune Conditional Access policies enforcing device compliance, sign-in risk, location, and application-based controls. Administer Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for all administrative roles, including just-in- time elevation, access reviews, approval workflows, and break-glass procedures. Implement and enforce passwordless and phishing-resistant authentication (FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business, certificate-based authentication). Operate Identity Protection, sign-in/audit log analytics, and identity-related incident response in partnership with Information Security. Endpoint Management Own Microsoft Intune as the primary MDM/MAM platform for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Design compliance policies, configuration profiles, app protection policies, Autopilot deployment, Windows Update for Business rings, and driver/firmware management. Establish the device-compliance signal path into Entra Conditional Access to support a Zero Trust posture. Lead migration of legacy MDM platforms (e.g., Verizon MDM) into Intune and decommission legacy management tooling. PKI and Certificate Services Own the design and operation of DNWest’s internal PKI based on Active Directory Certificate Services, including offline root CA, issuing CAs, HSM-backed keys, and certificate templates. Issue and manage certificates for device authentication, 802.1X/RADIUS, code signing, web services, S/MIME, and SCEP/NDES integration with Intune. Maintain certificate lifecycle automation, revocation (CRL/OCSP) infrastructure, and documented key ceremonies. Scripting, Automation, and DevOps Develop and maintain automation in PowerShell (primary), with supporting code in Python, Rust, TypeScript, or C# as appropriate, for identity provisioning/deprovisioning, configuration baselines, reporting, and incident response. Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (Bicep, Terraform, ARM) and pipeline-driven deployment of M365, Entra, and Azure resources. Operate source control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, code review, and release management practices for all IT-owned code and configuration. Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging for cloud and identity systems, including integration with SIEM and IT operational dashboards. Governance, Compliance, and Documentation Ensure all owned systems comply with HIPAA, DNWest IT policy, OPTN/CMS/UNOS requirements, and applicable NIST controls. Maintain operational runbooks, architecture diagrams, change records, and SOPs under DNWest’s controlled document management process. Participate in change management, problem management, and on-call rotations as required. Provide Tier 3 escalation support to the Service Desk for cloud, identity, and endpoint issues. OPO Industry Requirements Keeps up to date with OPO industry direction, guidance, and requirements. Problem Resolution Anticipates, mitigates, identifies, troubleshoots, and resolves hardware and software problems. Project Support Supports the Business Intelligence and Development group throughout project lifecycles. Reporting Provides performance, project status, and security reports on a weekly and monthly basis for management. System Administration Supports Windows and Linux servers (installation, patching, configuration). Assists with managing Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy Objects. Maintains system documentation, including configurations and standard operating procedures. Responds to and resolves incidents and service requests promptly System Performance Analysis Assists with managing and analyzing system, server, application, network, and device performance SKILLS REQUIRED Expert-level knowledge of modern authentication protocols and best practices. Expert-level knowledge of identify management and governance. Expert-level administration of Microsoft Intune across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, including Autopilot, compliance, and app protection policies. Expert-level operation of Active Directory Certificate Services, including multi-tier CA hierarchies, HSM integration, template design, and SCEP/NDES. Deep working knowledge of Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Purview, Defender) and Microsoft Graph. Expert-level knowledge of interface and API design as well as industry best practices. Strong knowledge of application design and software architecture principles. Strong scripting and development skills in PowerShell, with working proficiency in at least one of Python, Go, Rust, TypeScript, or C#. Working knowledge of data structures and algorithms. Practical experience with infrastructure-as-code (Bicep, Terraform, ARM, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of network and security fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, 802.1X/RADIUS, VPN, and firewall policy. Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage multiple concurrent priorities, and exercise sound technical judgment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation and engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. DONOR NETWORK WEST STAFF EXPECTATIONS Supports the vision, mission, and values of DNWest in every aspect of performance. Achieves strategic initiatives by providing constructive feedback and offering solutions to workplace challenges or obstacles. Foresees challenges, is proactive and uses sound judgement and best practices when solving problems and making decisions. Conducts work professionally and collaboratively and provides excellent customer service. Positively adapts to change, supports new initiatives, and is creative/innovative. Demonstrates emotional intelligence by having respectful interactions that bring about productive communication. Partners with internal and external contacts in a constructive manner to achieve goals. Collaborates with leadership and peers to set professional and personal development goals; and actively works to achieve them. Works in a safe, secure, legal, and professional manner in the workplace. Adheres to DNWest’s policies and code of conduct EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Education Required: High School graduate or GED equivalent. Experience Required: Minimum of 5 years’ experience in IT, systems engineering, software development, or a related field, with at least 3 years involving cloud services in a production environment. $107,415 - $134,210 a year Donor Network West takes a market-based approach to pay. All candidates’ starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications and interview performance. Our job listings’ compensation ranges include location-based differentials but may not be reflective of a candidate’s final base salary. Location differentials are determined by an employee’s home address, associated market data provided by government reporting and processed by Payroll. If selected, Donor Network West’s Recruiting & Compensation Team will provide further detail! Salary data provided by third party sites do not accurately reflect our pay structure.

Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding…
items.description: Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable. You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy. As a Data Analyst, you will: Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps. Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency, Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. or incongruence in clinical records. Establish and maintain clear, transparent reporting on ADT coverage across key geographic, organizational, and technological dimensions (e.g., by county, facility, and underlying EMR system). Based on rigorous analysis of data flow and quality, recommend and guide the implementation of optimal technical configurations for existing data vendors (e.g., Bamboo Health, PCC, Experian, HSX). Conduct comprehensive evaluations and proof-of-concepts for potential new data integration technologies (e.g., Kno2 vs. Particle Health) to assess viability, quality improvements, and strategic fit. Systematically determine the existence and completeness of documentation associated with specific patient visits or encounters. Develop a data-driven framework for prioritizing facility targets for direct data acquisition, assessing impact, cost-effectiveness, and technical feasibility. Inform and guide vendor strategy around national initiatives such as TEFCA and QHIN adoption, ensuring Counterpart Health is positioned for compliant, high-quality data exchange. Partner cross-functionally with Product Managers to define data requirements, Engineers to implement reliable pipelines, and Clinical teams to validate data quality and clinical utility. Act as a critical liaison to identify and remove operational and technical bottlenecks, ensuring a predictable, scalable, and reliable clinical data flow across all customer markets. You should get in touch if you have: 2+ years of hands-on data analytics experience, with direct exposure to healthcare data interoperability Strong hands-on experience with healthcare data standards: HL7, CCDA, and ADT messages. Proficiency in SQL and comfort working with large, complex datasets (claims, clinical logs, interoperability data). Background in analyzing interoperability networks (e.g., Carequality, CommonWell, eHealthExchange) or HIE integrations. Skilled at data visualization and able to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong investigative mindset, i.e., you enjoy digging into the “why” behind missing data and diverging metrics. Self-directed and able to manage multiple analytical projects (vendor comparisons, visit-level reconciliation) without constant supervision. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $77,000—$100,000 USD

items.description: About CookUnity : Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Role As a Senior Product Data Analyst , you will be an analytical partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and User Research. You will help teams understand both sides of CookUnity's marketplace: how customers find meals that fit their lives and how chef supply, variety, and merchandising shape that experience. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions. Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. You will help them distinguish meaningful customer and business outcomes from activity, evaluate tradeoffs across the funnel and customer lifecycle, and make insights accessible in day-to-day decisions. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and close cross-functional partnership. What You'll Do in 12 Months Make the marketplace easier to discover and more relevant: Study how customers browse chefs, meals, cuisines, dietary options, and price points. Analyze the relationship between local assortment, variety, personalization, and ordering behavior. Help Product identify where better discovery or merchandising can improve repeat ordering and retention. Improve the journey from first visit to lasting habit: Map the customer funnel from acquisition through first order, early repeat orders, and longer-term retention. Find friction in onboarding, menu exploration, checkout, and weekly ordering. Segment customers thoughtfully so teams can improve conversion and retention without hiding weak experiences behind averages. Measure product bets with credible experiments: Partner with Product and Engineering to define hypotheses, primary metrics, guardrails, sample sizes, and holdouts for changes to the funnel, personalization, loyalty, and in-product interventions. Analyze heterogeneous effects and uncertainty, and recommend whether to launch, iterate, or stop. When a randomized test is impractical, use the strongest available observational approach and explain its limits. Connect customer value to marketplace economics: Help teams evaluate how product changes affect order rate, churn, revenue per customer, discounts, chef engagement, and unit economics together. For new categories and ordering formats, define the measures that show whether customers find value and whether the model can scale. Reduce the work and stress of ordering: Combine behavioral data with research and customer feedback to understand where subscriptions, delivery information, account management, or support journeys create friction. Measure whether self-service and product improvements solve the underlying problem, not just move contacts to another channel. Build a trusted measurement foundation: Define and document product metrics, cohorts, event tracking, and dashboards. Work with Engineering and Data partners to validate instrumentation and maintain reliable behavioral data. Create compelling dashboards that let product teams explore results, spot meaningful patterns, and monitor outcomes after launch. Shape a focused learning agenda: Work with Product, Design, and User Research to prioritize the most consequential unknowns, design analyses and tests, and tell a clear story about what the team learned. Share methods and review work with other analysts to raise the quality of product analytics across the team. What Success Looks Like Product teams use clear metrics and guardrails to make decisions about discovery, conversion, ordering, and retention. Major launches are supported by credible tests or well-explained evidence, including their impact on different customer segments. Insights lead to measurable improvements in customer experience and repeat ordering while accounting for marketplace and financial tradeoffs. Stakeholders trust and regularly use self-service reporting, and core behavioral data is sufficiently complete to diagnose product performance. Core Competences/Requirements Approximately 5–7 years in product analytics or a closely related analytical role, with demonstrated ownership of complex analyses and influence on product decisions. Equivalent experience and evidence of impact are welcome. Practical fluency with AI tools for accelerating analysis, coding, research synthesis, documentation, and repeatable workflows; able to verify outputs and handle company and customer data responsibly. Strong SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large, complex behavioral datasets; ability to validate data and write clear, reusable analyses. Practical command of product metrics, funnel and cohort analysis, segmentation, and marketplace or subscription dynamics. Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including holdouts, guardrails, uncertainty, and tradeoffs; sound judgment about causal claims. Ability to turn an ambiguous product problem into a focused learning plan, work independently, and communicate an actionable recommendation. Clear data storytelling and constructive partnership with Product, Design, Engineering, User Research, and business teams. Ability to build powerful, intuitive dashboards in any tool that answer important product questions, reveal actionable insights, and enable trustworthy self-service analysis. Ability to evaluate AI-enabled product experiences through clear success metrics, experiments, user feedback, and appropriate quality and safety checks. Curiosity about food, chefs, customer behavior, and the practical constraints of operating a local marketplace. Benefits 💸 Get paid in USD. 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want. ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date. 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays. 🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider. 🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical. 🐣 Paid family leave. 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises. 🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more. 🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster. 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach. If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time! CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability. A quick note for all candidates We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us: Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page . We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away. If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

items.description: Job Title: PhD Scientist - STEM Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote(Worldwide) Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role Location: Fully remote You’ll need: A completed PhD in a STEM field, plus hands-on research experience Your tasks: Build difficult technical problems from your own research and define what makes an answer correct These tasks are hard to build, and that’s the point. We’re looking for people with genuine depth in their field: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking answer is quietly wrong. Required Skills Research Data Analysis Experimental Design Scientific Writing Statistical Analysis Laboratory Skills Wet Lab Clinical Research MATLAB Python SolidWorks Biostatistics Epidemiology Clinical Trials Data Visualization Spectroscopy Chromatography What you’ll do Design difficult technical problems drawn from your own research area, with realistic constraints and supporting data. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another researcher reviewing the work would reach the same verdict. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them. What we’re looking for Completed PhD in a STEM field. This is a hard requirement. Hands-on research experience — work you did yourself, not work you read about. Wet lab, research lab, or academic experience is strongly preferred. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another researcher could verify it. Publications or a record of research contribution is a strong plus. Prior experience on AI training or evaluation projects is a plus, not a requirement. How the selection process works Apply and complete the screening questions Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client Profile review Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Engineer
items.summary: Hivex is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our dynamic team.
items.description: Hivex is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering with hands-on experience in various tools and technologies. As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining our data infrastructure and pipelines to ensure reliable data flows across the organization. Requirements: 4.5+ years of experience in a data engineering role Proficiency in AWS RDS and Snowflake for database management Hands-on experience with Fivetran, DBT, and Prefect Experience with Looker Familiarity with Datadog for monitoring and performance optimization English level - B2 Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously Responsibilities : Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using tools such as Fivetran, DBT, and Prefect. Manage and administer databases on AWS RDS and Snowflake to ensure optimal performance and data integrity. Design and implement data models and ETL processes to support business intelligence and analytics. Work with Looker to create and maintain insightful reports and dashboards. Monitor and optimize data workflows and performance using Datadog. Ensure data quality, security, and compliance with industry standards and best practices. Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues and provide ongoing support to data users across the organization. What we offer: Remote job with the freedom to work from anywhere in the world. Flexible work schedule tailored to your life and work needs. Competitive and timely salary. Opportunities for professional growth and development. The chance to gain experience in various fields and participate in exciting projects. Your ideas and initiatives are always welcome and valued. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Utah URL: https://www.chirocat.com/ About Us and Why We're Hiring We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients. The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in! We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us. That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us. What We're Looking For REQUIREMENTS For this role, you must: Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan) Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow) Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving! Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS These aren't required, but will help you stand out: Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell. Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom) Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google) Comfort making short-form video Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.) Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume. Life at ChiroCat ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do. HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify. Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone. Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler channel! Great Benefits: We offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of the premium covered for you and affordable rates for dependents. This is a salaried role with a starting salary of $95k–$130k a year. Most new hires start in the lower to middle part of that range, and the top end is reserved for the rare candidates with truly exceptional, deep, and directly relevant experience. You’ll Make a Real Impact: This role will have an incredible impact on the lives of our doctors and staff, not to mention the patients they serve. You’ll be instrumental in helping chiropractors find and trust ChiroCat as their EHR of choice. ChiroCat is the core of their business and their ability to serve patients, so their success with ChiroCat has far-reaching implications. Additionally, we're growing, and the road ahead is exciting. You'd be joining at a stage where you can meaningfully shape our brand and voice, perception in the market, and our trajectory. That kind of impact doesn't come along often. And do it with Great People: We're firm believers that the foundation of success is building a great team. You’ll be joining a team full of truly exceptional people. The kind you’ll be excited to work with and learn to care about. People who get stuff done. Who are genuine to their core. Who hold humility and confidence equally well at the same time. Who support each other and care deeply about our customers. It’s a strong culture that’s apparent the moment you walk through the [digital] door. And we can’t wait to see how you’ll make us even better. If this sounds like your ideal environment, read on because now we’ll dig into the role itself. What You'll Do at ChiroCat At ChiroCat, marketing isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room. It’s about being the most trustworthy one. Chiropractors get plenty of noise from software vendors: big promises, long contracts, and slick ads for products that feel twenty years old. We want people to meet the real ChiroCat, the same one our customers already know. Everything we put into the world should sound like us, look like us, and be true. Your early focus will be brand: making sure that whatever someone sees of ChiroCat, whether it’s our website, our ads, our social posts, our reviews, or the messages inside our app, gives them an accurate (and awesome) picture of who we are. Next up is widening the funnel and building our inbound lead flow. Down the road, perhaps you’ll build a marketing team, one amazing hire at a time, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves. This role reports to the CEO and works closely with our Head of Customer Success, our CTO, and our Sales team. A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT INCLUDE: Rewriting a page of our website so it sounds like us, and not like every other EHR vendor Taking over our Facebook ads from our CEO (Psst… he’s relieved, and honestly, so are the ads and the people viewing them!) Jumping into a Facebook group thread where chiropractors are comparing software, and being genuinely curious and helpful instead of defensive or salesy. Planning next week’s social posts, and making sure at least one of them shows off the people behind ChiroCat (our team is way more fun than our current feed suggests); next week you’ll execute that plan. Working with our Customer Success team to rewrite in-app messages so new customers feel like they’re hearing from ChiroCat, not a robot Responding to a G2 review thoughtfully and honestly Sitting in on a sales call or reading through support chats to hear how chiropractors actually describe their problems Briefing a designer on next week’s ad creative, or making it yourself Drafting an email campaign that people actually want to open Bringing a proposal to the CEO: “Here’s what I think we should work on first, and why.” Learning the difference between a 98940 and a 98941 (you’ll get there, we promise) You’re the right fit if: You think in brand, not just funnel. Leads matter, and you know how to get them (we’ll need lots of them). But you also know that the way people feel about us impacts our success from beginning to end. Words matter to you. You obsess over the right word and notice when a sentence is trying too hard. You can write in a voice that isn’t your own, yet somehow make it sound effortless. You don’t wait for the next task. You look around, spot what’s missing, and come up with a plan. You’re the driver, not a passenger. You have taste. You can tell when something looks off, sounds generic, or feels like it came out of a template (or AI), and you won’t ship it. You’re humbly confident. You’ll make a strong case for your ideas, and you’ll change your mind when someone shows you something better. You love being a jack of all trades. Writing copy in the morning, digging into ad performance after lunch, and tweaking a landing page before you log off sounds like a great day to you. You measure what matters. You care about results more than activity, and you’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t. You’re obsessive about getting a good ROI on our ad spend and efforts. You love learning complex things. Chiropractic workflows? Insurance billing? How a front desk really runs? You’ll dive in. Because you can’t market what you don’t understand. You’d rather build than maintain. A website that needs a rethink and a brand that’s still taking shape sounds like an opportunity to you, not a mess. You see feedback as a gift. Even when it’s offered imperfectly but kindly, you stay curious instead of defensive, and look for the nugget that helps you grow. Ready to Apply? Apply (here: https://apply.workable.com/chirocat/j/5198B94A48?utm_source=wwr ) by 11:59 PM on Monday, November 30th, 2026. TWO IMPORTANT NOTES: We don’t want to see AI answers (yes, we can tell). We use AI at ChiroCat all the time, but we’re hiring you, not an AI agent. We want YOUR answers. We review applications as they come in, so we might find our perfect fit early! We don’t recommend waiting until the last minute. WHAT TO INCLUDE (IN PDF FORMAT, PLEASE): Your resume A cover letter (Yep, we read them!) Page 1: Skip the formal stuff and help us get to know you. Pretend we just met at a picnic. Introduce yourself, explain why you’re interested, and why you think you’d be great in this role. Include the word "rambunctious" somewhere (we want to make sure you're real and read this whole thing). Page 2: Answer this in 1-2 paragraphs: “Pretend you’re hiring for this role. What is the most important trait or skill you’re looking for in an applicant? Why?” PS: Not interested, but know someone who might be? Please pass it along! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/chirocat-humbly-confident-marketing-lead

items.description: About Figure We’re Figure (Nasdaq: FIGR), and we’re building the future of capital markets with blockchain and AI. We make lending faster and cheaper for everyone by automating the origination process and using blockchain as the source of truth for loan ownership and connection to our capital marketplace. It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business: Lending: HELOCs, cash-out refinance, DSCR loans, and crypto-backed loans for homeowners, investors, and small businesses. Through Kiavi, a Figure company, we also finance real estate investors with bridge, fix-and-flip, rental, and new construction loans. Markets: On Figure Markets, people can lend and earn with Prime and $YLDS, an SEC-registered, interest-bearing security that settles like cash. OPEN is our blockchain infrastructure for issuing, distributing, and trading equities. Partnerships: Banks, credit unions, fintechs, home improvement companies, and other lenders and brokers originate loans on our platform. DART records loan ownership on blockchain, and Figure Connect connects originators with institutional loan buyers. See all of our products on figure.com. Here’s where we are today: $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform 382K+ households served 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s $23B+ funded for real estate investors through Kiavi since 2013 Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000) If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Manager Servicing Financial Transaction and Portfolio Management to join our growing team! As Senior Manager Servicing Financial Transaction and Portfolio Management, you’ll own servicing financial transaction management, loan portfolio performance, and forecasting. You’ll lead a team of analysts on monthly servicing transaction reconciliations and act as the main Servicing Operations partner to the leaders of Finance, Credit, Loss Forecasting, Capital Markets, and Investors. Your work shapes decisions on sub-servicer performance, portfolio recovery, and risk mitigation. If you want to own the numbers that drive servicing results and are ready to turn them into decisions, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Own servicing investor reporting end to end, including revenue, ancillary fees, sub-servicing costs, advances, recoveries, and corporate allocations Set KPI targets, explain loan transaction activity to investors, and drive actions that improve recoveries Lead MSR valuation support, including governance of discount rate, CPR/prepayment, delinquency, and cost-to-service assumptions, and partner with Capital Markets, Credit, and Finance on retention strategies Drive the roadmap for loan performance, delinquency migration, loss mitigation results, foreclosure, and collection effectiveness, and turn findings into recommendations for operations and credit leaders Lead the long-range plan and rolling forecasts for servicing revenue, default expense, foreclosure timelines, recoveries, and REO performance under different rate and macro scenarios Oversee escrow and advance modeling, recoverability analysis, and investor-level cost allocation Partner with Servicing leadership on cost-to-service reduction, vendor and sub-servicer economics, automation, and build-vs-buy decisions Own monthly and quarterly business reviews, variance analysis, and KPI reporting for executive leadership Build and maintain the financial risk and compliance monitoring framework for the servicing portfolio, and act as the finance point of contact for audits, regulators, and investor reviews Hire, develop, and manage a team of financial and portfolio analysts, set priorities, review their work, and raise the quality of modeling, data, and reporting What We Look For 8-12+ years of mortgage FP&A, investor reporting, servicing analytics, or portfolio management experience, with 3+ years managing people Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Business, or a related field Deep expertise in MSR economics, delinquency and loss modeling, advance mechanics, and servicing cost structures Hands-on familiarity with servicing systems (MSP, Sagent, LoanServ) and data tools (SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI), plus experience leading analytics teams that use them Manage complex workloads independently and deliver against strict deadlines Turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for executive leaders Experience working with Capital Markets, Operations, Risk, and Compliance, often under tight deadlines MBA or related master’s degree (preferred) CPA, CFA, or similar certification (preferred) Experience with MSR transactions, sub-servicing oversight, or investor/GSE reporting (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Ginnie Mae) (preferred) Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures. Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes. Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team. Salary Base Compensation Range: $156,813 - $235,219/yr 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly Company equity in the form of RSUs This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above. Benefits Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefit Employer-paid life and disability insurance 10 observed holidays and PTO plan Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave Continuing education reimbursement Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice. Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. #LI-JR1 #LI-Remote

items.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Sales Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and other teams across Stripe to drive highly strategic initiatives. This team is integral in the success of our sales organization. With a commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the art and science of sales, our team is dedicated to informing the sales strategy, optimising processes, and providing insights that propel our sales growth. We do this by being objective, trusted partners to the Sales Leadership team. What you’ll do We are seeking a technically sophisticated and detail oriented individual who will serve as a Sales Strategy and Operations Data Analyst in support of the AMER Velocity (Commercial and SMB) business. This person will be responsible for improving the quality of sales analytics and insights, including standardization of reporting and scalability with the primary objective of enabling sales leadership to make effective, analytically driven decisions. You will work primarily with Sales Leadership and other cross-functional business partners to drive the operational cadence and strategy/planning of the business. Responsibilities Operating Cadence: Execute on a standard weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence of operations (weekly forecasting calls, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews). Business Insights: Develop a deep understanding of the Velocity business and its sales funnel. Provide actionable insights and a strategic perspective on business performance to help inform key decisions. Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to business leads and influence strategic decision-making. Strategy / Planning: Analyze sales and revenue data and other metrics to build models and provide actionable recommendations to shape the strategy during the annual planning process (resource planning, territory design, target/quota setting and management). Program and Process Management: Independently develop and manage project or program plans to support requests from key stakeholder and core operational planning processes. Manage segment wide operational processes and programs including but not limited to sales territory development. Scalable Insight: Conceptualize, build, manage and maintain centralized tools (including spreadsheet models, dashboards) that the business and Sales Strategy & Operations team can use to extract data / insights for daily business management in an automated manner to drive current and future rhythms of business. As a result of insights, identify and improve the usability and accessibility of insights from existing systems and tools, in collaboration with respective development teams. Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. items.description: About the Role Albireo Energy is seeking an Automation Design Engineer to design, develop, and deliver automation and monitoring systems for mission-critical data center projects. This role spans Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), Building Management Systems (BMS), and SCADA platforms, covering the full project lifecycle from engineering design and documentation through control system development and field commissioning. This role balances automation development with hands-on design. You will be expected to keep up with design tasks on your projects, including producing and revising drawing packages in AutoCAD, alongside your SCADA, PLC, and commissioning responsibilities. You will report to the Engineering Manager as part of a central engineering team supporting strategic projects nationwide, collaborating closely with design leads, project managers, field execution teams, and our solutions architecture and sales teams. You will also work directly with customers, consultants, contractors, and equipment manufacturers. We are looking for an engineer who can take ownership of assigned design scopes, work independently, solve problems proactively, and grow into technical leadership. We actively support professional development, including Ignition certifications (Core and Gold) and hands-on PLC programming experience. Key Responsibilities: Design and Documentation Produce, revise, and maintain design drawings in AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical, including control panel layouts, wiring and termination diagrams, network riser diagrams, P&IDs, enclosure details, and installation details. Keep design packages current throughout the project lifecycle, incorporating RFI responses, design changes, field redlines, and as-built conditions. Apply and help improve company CAD standards, including title blocks, layers, symbol libraries, drawing numbering, and revision control. Coordinate drawing updates with device lists, point lists, and BOMs to keep documentation consistent across the package. Read and interpret customer specifications, electrical one-lines, mechanical drawings, and owner standards to define automation scope and system requirements. Develop control system architectures and sequences of operation for EPMS, BMS, and SCADA systems, including mechanical cooling and electrical distribution monitoring. Select and specify controllers, PLCs, power meters, gateways, sensors, transmitters, network switches, and related hardware. Prepare submittal packages that clearly communicate system design and operation to customers, consultants, subcontractors, and field installation teams. Coordinate with equipment manufacturers on communication maps, register lists, connection details, and design compatibility. Follow internal workflows for drawing management, RFIs, and submittals in Autodesk Build, and contribute to project startup standards. Testing and Commissioning Support field teams through installation, startup, commissioning, and cutover, both on site and remotely. Track commissioning progress, device verification, and open issues using tools such as CxAlloy and Basecamp. Contribute to MOP development for work performed in live, mission-critical environments. Deliver as-built drawings, closeout documentation, and O&M materials. Collaboration and Leadership Support solutions architects and sales with conceptual designs, scope reviews, and estimating. Communicate progress, schedule risks, and design changes early to the design lead or project manager, along with recommended solutions. Mentor junior designers and field technicians, and delegate tasks where appropriate. Manage assigned scopes within budgeted hours and committed deliverable dates. Adhere to all health, safety, and electrical safety procedures, including NFPA 70E. 3–5 years of experience in automation, controls, SCADA, or systems integration engineering. 2+ years of hands-on experience producing engineering drawings in AutoCAD, with the ability to independently create and revise control, wiring, and layout drawings. Working knowledge of drafting principles, drawing standards, and revision control. Hands-on experience integrating systems in Ignition or a comparable SCADA/HMI platform. Experience reading, modifying, and troubleshooting PLC programs (Allen-Bradley/Studio 5000 preferred). Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical drawings, P&IDs, and specifications. Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, BACnet, SNMP, EtherNet/IP). Experience with full-lifecycle project delivery: design, development, testing, and commissioning. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort in client-facing settings. Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple tasks, and meet deadlines. Ability to work effectively in a multi-location, remote team using tools such as Microsoft Teams. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Willingness to travel approximately 25–50%, with heavier periods during commissioning. Preferred Qualifications BS in Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical, Computer, or Controls Engineering, or a related technical field. Proficiency in AutoCAD Electrical, including symbol libraries, wire numbering, and automated reports. Experience creating or maintaining CAD standards. Ignition Core Certification (Gold Certification a plus). Data center, mission-critical, pharmaceutical, or other regulated-industry experience. Experience with EPMS or BMS design and integration. Experience with DCS platforms such as DeltaV, or with process controls. Experience with Revit or other BIM tools. Scripting experience (Python/Jython, SQL) for SCADA applications. Familiarity with power meters and electrical distribution equipment (switchgear, UPS, PDUs, generators). Experience with Autodesk Build, CxAlloy, or similar project and commissioning tools. Experience supporting proposals or solutions development. What We Offer Work on large-scale, mission-critical data center projects. Support for professional development, including Ignition Core and Gold certification. Hands-on growth across design, PLC programming, SCADA development, and commissioning. A collaborative engineering team with a clear path toward Design Lead responsibilities. Compensation $100,000–$125,000 per year, depending on experience. Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Basic Life Insurance Voluntary Life Insurance Short Term & Long Term Disability Paid Vacation Paid Sick Time Paid Holidays 401K with Company match Pre-Employment Requirements: All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of applicable pre-employment screenings, which may include a background check and drug screening, conducted in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Positions where driving is an essential function will also require a satisfactory Motor Vehicle Record (MVR). Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Agency Submissions: Albireo Energy does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from third-party recruiting agencies. Candidate ownership will only be recognized when submitted under an active, authorized agreement and through our official Applicant Tracking System. Submissions received without a prior agreement will be considered the property of Albireo Energy. Albireo Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: Guest Experience is responsible for Search and Discovery, Merchandising, and end-to-end online software experience worldwide from top-of-funnel discovery through post-booking engagement. We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Guest Data Science team. This tech lead will be at the core of using AI and casual inference to understand user behavior in our app, detect underlying intent, and to build data products needed to provide a compelling and personalized experience of our app. We build products that help guests find the inventory most relevant to them in our marketplace. The Difference You Will Make: As a Senior Staff Data Scientist, you will lead innovation efforts to build methodologies to identify and evaluate the preferences important to every guest, at every step of their online discovery funnel. You will be instrumental in shaping our data strategy to drive guest conversion and regular engagement with the Airbnb platform across our Homes, Experiences and Services business verticals. This role emphasizes technical excellence and driving business impact with cutting-edge science. Your role will involve close collaboration with Product to identify in-product optimizations and shape UX design architecture to path how guests navigate from surface-to-surface in our app. The ideal candidate will demonstrate to be a domain expert with granular user behavior and sequence datasets in a marketplace setting. You will hold a high bar for our customer experience and balance a passion for AI with a strong desire to accurately understand user behavior and business success. Your efforts towards personalized content discovery will help make Airbnb feel tailored for you, maintaining a dialogue with our guests to deeply understand their preferences and reflect that understanding back to them, enabling every guest to easily discover the travel they will love. A Typical Day: Learn: Develop deep understanding of how guests navigate and re-engage with our app via analysis, research, and by leveraging granular user action and sequence datasets. Partner: With product and engineering, drive technical frameworks and science leadership to explore innovative paradigms for detecting revealed preferences and quantifying online frictions. Build: Write code for prototypes to detect and quantify taxonomy of guest preferences via iterative development of data frameworks, models and artefacts derived from AI toolkits Evaluate: Assess assumptions and efficacy of derived guest preferences via measurement and validating hypotheses linked to online guest action and engagement. Setup experiments and data feedback loops to own a high bar over continuous impact. Influence: Regularly present findings and recommendations to leadership audiences to inform strategy and cross-functional deliverables. If you’re passionate about going deep into personalized user experiences, we want to hear from you! Your Expertise: Causal inference expertise with marketplace experience Preferred domain experience in search, UX discovery, personalized evidence systems Advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Econometrics or related field. 9+ years of industry experience with a PhD (or 12+ years with a Masters) Strong in communication with XFN partners in product, engineering, and design to enable data-driven product development with a focus on the user experience. Expert in at least one programming language for data analysis (Python or R) with familiarity in SQL. Comfort with developing proof-of-concept prototypes. Passionate about AI and possessing a learner’s mindset towards LLMs and dynamic systems. Proven ability to succeed in both collaborative and independent work environments Demonstrated willingness and track record of engagement with the technical community Your Location: This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Equal Employment Opportunity: Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $224,000 — $280,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - India Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Oportun’s Model Risk Management team and help provide independent oversight of models used across the business. You’ll evaluate model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, performance, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure models are appropriate, well-controlled, and aligned with Oportun’s risk-management standards. This is a senior individual contributor role that combines quantitative analysis, independent model validation, governance, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work closely with model developers, Risk, Data Science, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to challenge model approaches, identify material risks, and strengthen model risk practices across Oportun. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll independently review and validate statistical, machine learning, and decisioning models used across Oportun, including models supporting consumer credit loss forecasting, liquidity and funding, and capital markets activities. You’ll assess model methodology, assumptions, data quality, feature selection, implementation, performance, stability, and limitations. You’ll perform quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back-testing, and other validation activities. You’ll review model monitoring frameworks and help identify performance deterioration, emerging risks, and areas requiring remediation. You’ll evaluate model documentation for completeness, clarity, reproducibility, and alignment with model risk management standards. You’ll provide effective challenges to model developers and business stakeholders while maintaining constructive working relationships. You’ll communicate validation findings, model risks, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. You’ll support model governance processes, including model inventory, risk tiering, validation scheduling, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up. You’ll partner with Risk, Compliance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and other teams to strengthen model controls and governance practices. You’ll help improve model risk frameworks, validation methodologies, documentation standards, monitoring practices, and governance processes. You’ll use data and analytics to identify trends and emerging risks across the model portfolio. You’ll look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, and model risk workflows while maintaining appropriate human review. You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a rigorous and curious quantitative professional who enjoys understanding how models work, where they can fail, and how their risks should be managed. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking detailed questions, and supporting your conclusions with clear analysis. You combine technical depth with strong judgment and communication skills. You can work independently, explain complex quantitative issues clearly, and build credibility with model developers and senior stakeholders. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 5+ years of experience in data science, model validation, model risk management, quantitative risk, statistics, or a related field. Strong understanding of statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as logistic regression, gradient boosting, decision trees, neural networks, or similar methods. Strong understanding of how defaults, recoveries, prepayments, loan seasoning, and macroeconomic conditions influence consumer loan portfolio losses and cash flows. Experience developing or validating consumer credit loss forecasting models using methods such as vintage/cohort analysis, roll-rate or transition models, survival analysis, time-series models, or probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), and exposure at default (EAD) frameworks.Strong proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar quantitative programming tools. Experience working with large datasets and performing advanced statistical analysis, model testing, or performance evaluation. Strong understanding of model validation techniques, performance metrics, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, stability analysis, and ongoing monitoring. Experience evaluating model assumptions, data quality, limitations, implementation, and business use. Experience independently leading complex analytical or validation work from scoping through final conclusions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings and explain complex model risks clearly. Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with model developers, Risk, Compliance, and senior stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience in model risk management or independent model validation. Experience with credit risk, fraud risk, consumer lending, fintech, banking, or another regulated financial services environment. Familiarity with model governance frameworks, model inventories, risk tiering, validation schedules, issue management, or regulatory expectations. Experience validating machine learning or AI models. Experience developing or validating liquidity, funding, or cash-flow forecasting models, including evaluating funding needs and liquidity under stress scenarios. Familiarity with capital markets models used for loan valuation or securitization, including assessing how key assumptions affect valuations and projected cash flows.Experience with AWS, SageMaker, Databricks, or other cloud-based analytics and modeling platforms. Experience with Spark, PySpark, Hive, or other large-scale data technologies. Master’s degree or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance, or another quantitative discipline. Experience using AI-assisted tools to support research, coding, documentation, validation, or quantitative analysis. Our AI Mindset We b uild with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together . Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: India Benefits: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance Provident Fund Life & Accident Insurance Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-data-scientist-model-risk-management-r14365
