Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals. Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk. Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives. Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory. Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization. Minimum Qualifications Experience: 8 - 12 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly. Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives. Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles. Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy. Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below: Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS. Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts. Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3. AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows. Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions. Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments. Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The “Good-to-Haves”) Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls. Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2. Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth. Education Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Travel This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration. Compensation This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion. For Netherlands based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €111,000 - €174,000. The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. items.description: WHO WE ARE Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using. Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees. Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay. WHAT YOU WILL DO We are looking for a Senior Engineering Team Lead to take ownership of our Reporting platform and lead the team responsible for its evolution. This is a player-coach role for a staff-level data engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership and people management skills. You will help design, deploy, and evolve the data infrastructure that powers Adikteev’s reporting and analytics systems. You will be both the technical architect of the platform and the manager of the team that enables reliable, scalable, and high-value reporting for our internal and external users. As the team lead, you won't just "execute" tasks. You will shape our technical DNA and support the growth of the team. Engineering: Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Reporting platform and data infrastructure. Architect, scale, and maintain our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the rigorous demands of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence workflows. Make sure data is always available and reliable: oversee processing, storage, aggregation, transformation, and API development. Streamline our data processes by integrating efficient testing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and error recovery. Design and implement robust data models and transformation pipelines that make reporting data easy to discover, understand, and use. Build and optimize highly scalable pipelines using Apache Airflow and Apache Spark, focusing on high reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. Establish best practices for data quality, CI/CD for data, observability, technical documentation, and operational excellence. Contribute to innovation efforts by exploring promising ideas from recent academic and industry work and turning them into production-grade solutions. Leverage AI coding tools such as Copilot and Claude to accelerate development cycles and stay at the forefront of engineering productivity. Remain hands-on where it creates the most leverage, contributing to system design, code reviews, critical implementation work, and incident resolution. Management : Lead, support, and develop the Reporting engineering team, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work. Set clear objectives, priorities, and expectations for the team, aligned with company and product goals. Manage the team’s roadmap and delivery, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt, and long-term investments. Provide regular feedback, coaching, and career development support to team members. Mentor Data and Backend Engineers and help them grow their technical scope, ownership, and leadership skills. Participate in recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, and team planning. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high engineering standards. Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and technical risks before they impact the business, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. WHO YOU ARE You might be a great fit for our Reporting team if you have experience in several of the following areas: Experience : Proven track record as a Staff Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer, or Engineering Manager with a strong data engineering background. You have worked on production systems where latency, throughput, availability, reliability, and infrastructure cost matter. Data Volume : Experience working with very large-scale data systems. At Adikteev, our platforms process more than 5 billion events per day and reach over 5 million QPS on some services. You are comfortable designing systems that can handle high data volumes, demanding throughput, and strict reliability requirements. Technical Stack : Hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, including tuning and scaling, as well as Apache Airflow and complex DAG orchestration. Kafka streaming, Kubernetes, and AWS are a plus. Coding Skills : You are an "AI-native" developer who embraces AI tools to write better and faster code. Hands-on experience with Scala. Python and Java are a plus. Data Modeling : Strong experience designing data models for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. Experience with dimensional modeling, data warehouses, or data lakes is a plus. Data Transformation : Solid understanding of how to transform raw data into accurate, consistent, and easy-to-use reporting datasets. Experience building or maintaining reporting or analytics platforms is a strong plus. Engineering Leadership : Experience defining technical direction, setting engineering standards, driving execution across teams, and making architectural decisions at staff level. People Management : Experience managing, mentoring, and developing engineers, providing regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a high-performing team. Communication : Fluent in English and able to articulate complex architectural choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable creating alignment across teams and communicating clearly at every level. Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in the European Union in order to be considered for this position. COMPENSATION Competitive Salary between 100,000 and 120,000€ OTE We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role. PERKS AND BENEFITS 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off); Longevity bonus every 2 years; Profit-sharing scheme Healthcare plan with excellent coverage; Lunch Vouchers; Mental Health support; Flexible remote working policy; Regular team-life event / activity; Inclusive parental leave Policy. *Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are. OUR PROCESS What to expect as you move through our hiring process: HR call with Maxime, Team Lead - Talent Acquisition, Technical interview with Youcef, Senior Engineering Team Lead, & Adrian, Senior Data Engineer Team fit interview with Aldenis, VP Engineering, A final interview with Cédric, Chief Technology Officer and Loïc, Chief Product Officer. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team. OUR COMMITMENT We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future. Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Strong understanding of survey design principles and market research methodologies. Proven ability to analyze and interpret survey data using Qualtrics’ analytics tools. Demonstrated expertise in customer experience measurement and evaluation. Superb written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate processes and insights. Current authorized access to Qualtrics platform. Experience demonstrating research workflows or training others in survey management tools is a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Turkey URL: https://sezzle.com The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $4,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them. What You’ll Do: Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others What We Look For: Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering Fluent in English Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL The Tech You’ll Work With: Python Redshift, PostgreSQL Data build tool (dbt) WS, G Suite, Mac Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT Interview Process: Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue. Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service. Offer About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #Full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-data-engineer-ii-credit-reporting

items.description: Design Headquarters: Costa Rica, Remote Our Mission: 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems Location Costa Rica Function / Dept Business Technology — Enterprise Applications Reports to Director, Enterprise Applications Position Summary 6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals. This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes. Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies. A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences. This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value. Responsibilities Tool Inventory & AI Efficiency Discovery Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility. Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings. Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time. Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature. Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline. Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope. Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side. Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later. Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility. Prototyping & Applied AI Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved. Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production. Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled. Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations. Stakeholder Partnership Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status. Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on. Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition. Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues. Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones. Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers. Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off. Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies. Measurement & Ways of Working Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired. Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated. Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve. Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements. Skills & Experience Required 2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company. Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), including Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and reporting. Salesforce Certified Administrator, or obtained within the first six months in the role. Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar, with solid prompt design and an understanding of their limits. Strong spreadsheet and data fluency: cleaning data, building summaries and sizing a problem. Process mapping and structured interviewing skills. Clear written and spoken English; able to present findings to U.S.-based stakeholders. Must be located in Costa Rica and able to maintain consistent working overlap with U.S. business hours. Preferred Experience putting an AI or automation solution into a live business process, even a small one, and measuring the result. Familiarity with GTM processes (lead to cash, pipeline, forecasting) or Support operations (case management, routing, knowledge), or with Finance, Legal or Partner operations. Basic financial literacy: reading a vendor cost, comparing build and run cost, and calculating a payback period. Exposure to SQL, APIs or low-code tools; interest in using Claude Code under guidance. Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Agentforce Specialist. Experience in an Agile team; familiarity with Jira, Asana or similar. Bilingual English/Spanish. What we value Curiosity and a bias to build and test, not just to document. Honesty about what is validated and what is an estimate. Comfort with change, since this track is new and will keep evolving. How This Role Is Measured Accuracy and completeness of the tool inventory for your function. Percent of renewals in scope identified and reviewed at least 120 days before the notice date. Prototype quality, as rated by the stakeholder and the engineering lead. Hours returned and spend avoided on initiatives you support, validated by the business owner. Adoption of anything shipped in your function. What Success Looks Like First 90 days Inventory for your function is complete and reviewed with business owners. Renewal calendar for your tools is documented, with the next three renewals ranked by savings potential. Two or more stakeholder discovery sessions completed, with baselines drafted for the top opportunities. First prototype built with Claude or Copilot and reviewed with the Lead and an engineer. First year Your stakeholder group treats you as its partner for systems and AI work and routes requests to you rather than escalating. At least two prototypes evaluated end to end, and at least one taken to production with Enterprise AI Engineers, with measured impact. At least one initiative with a documented baseline, business-owner sign-off and a validated hours-returned or spend-avoided number. Renewals for your function reviewed before notice dates, with a documented decision on each. You are operating toward IC4: leading a build-vs-buy analysis from discovery to recommendation with little guidance. Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. items.description: StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. Senior Manager, Client Analytics Partnership - EMEA The Senior Manager of Client Analytics Partnership for EMEA leads a team of individual contributors responsible for developing client measurement strategies, delivering actionable insights and building strategic partnerships that support growth across the EMEA region. This role is a people manager role and also requires hands-on client support on high-priority client partnerships. The Sr. Manager identifies geo-specific measurement needs, shapes strategies, and leads global testing and reporting initiatives, ensuring the Client Analytics Partnership team delivers impactful insights and data-driven strategic client support while fostering innovation and team development. This role reports to the VP of Global Data & Analytics. StackAdapt is a remote-first company. Candidates should be based in London or the surrounding area, with regular travel to meet clients. What you will be doing: Lead the Client Analytics Partnership (CAP) team, ensuring strategic goals are met and pursuing market development. Oversee the development, education, and implementation of market-specific measurement strategies, testing plans, learning agendas, and reporting adoption across AM and AE teams. Provide direct support on high-priority client partnerships or vendor relationships that lead to overall team capability development. Help support recruitment and GTM of prioritised initiatives to feed the pipeline of potential case study candidates. Translate regional needs to scaled solutions teams or product team to develop client deliverables that meet their business/marketing reporting objectives. Demonstrate and incorporate AI and automation as the foundation for scaling best practices and analytics support. Influence StackAdapts EMEA market strategy by addressing repeated client reporting needs and anticipating future challenges. Identify and develop best practices that align with different verticals and business objectives, ensuring scalable client measurement solutions Serve as the primary measurement consultant for Sales and Client Service Leads and engages in leadership-level conversations for EMEA markets Advises on measurement strategy and planning in key new business development, and directly participates in client pitches Collaborates with NORAM counterparts to create enterprise-level measurement tactics and ensure efficient division of projects across the regions for collective efforts. Represent EMEA market needs to identify region-specific nuances in GTM materials. Partners closely with the scaled solutions, product and technical engineering team, though this role does not manage data engineering, pipelines, or dashboard development. What you’ll bring to the table: 7 to 9 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within the digital media or programmatic advertising landscape servicing clients. Experience leading and developing client-facing analytics or measurement professionals. Experience in guiding teams through measurement strategies, test designs and learning objectives to set KPIs. Knowledge of industry-standard performance metrics and media KPIs. Knowledge of regional ad policies and guardrails on privacy and data governance laws. Experience working with internal teams, cross-functional partners, and supporting client relationships. Proficiency in using reporting tools (such as Tableau, PowerBI, ThoughtSpot, BigQuery, and Google Analytics) and media buying platforms for data analysis. The ability to translate and articulate complex measurement concepts to both executive C-suite stakeholders and technical engineering audiences. Expert understanding of client servicing and campaign management. Deep understanding of measurement methodologies and strategies, including incrementality, brand and engagement lift, test design, attribution models (including the limitations of last-touch attribution and application of multi-touch attribution), and marketing mix modelling (MMM). The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in the posting country based on a global rate. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location. We do not ask c andidates about current or prior salary history, and we will not use such information, if volunteered, in setting an offer. This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package. Factors Influencing Final Compensation: The final compensation offer will be determined by a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to: the candidate's specific experience, technical skills, knowledge, abilities, and relevant education, licensure, and certifications. Other business factors, such as organizational needs and budget alignment, may also be considered in the final offer. Base Salary Band £114,773—£157,758 GBP StackAdapter's Enjoy: Highly competitive salary Retirement/ 401K/ Pension Savings globally Competitive Paid time off packages including birthday's off! Access to a comprehensive mental health care program Health benefits from day one of employment Work from home reimbursements Optional global WeWork membership for those who want a change from their home office and hubs in London and Toronto Robust training and onboarding program Coverage and support of personal development initiatives (conferences, courses, books etc) Access to StackAdapt programmatic courses and certifications to support continuous learning An awesome parental leave program A friendly, welcoming, and supportive culture Our social and team events! Please note: Benefits and perks may vary depending on your country of employment and the nature of your engagement. In locations where StackAdapt does not have a legal entity, employment and benefits are administered in accordance with local regulations and partner policies. StackAdapt is a diverse and inclusive team of collaborative, hardworking individuals trying to make a dent in the universe. No matter who you are, where you are from, who you love, follow in faith, disability, superpower status, ethnicity, or the gender you identify with (if you’re comfortable, let us know your pronouns), you are welcome at StackAdapt. StackAdapt is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know. We use artificial intelligence (AI) to streamline the resume reviews of candidates and assess their fit based on the criteria outlined in the job posting. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions. About StackAdapt We've been recognized for our diverse and supportive workplace, high performing campaigns, award-winning customer service, and innovation. We've been awarded: G2 Top Software for 2026 2026 Best Workplaces™ for Young Talent and in Canada by Great Place to Work® #1 DSP on G2 and leader in a number of categories including Cross-Channel Advertising 2026 Winner in the (CTV/OTT) Product/Platform category for the 2026 ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards To learn more about our privacy practices, please see our Privacy Policy . #LI-REMOTE

items.title: Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) - Canada
items.summary: At NerdWallet, our mission is to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Data Science plays a critical role in delivering on that mission, helping us better understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that best meet their needs. We’re growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Data…
items.description: At NerdWallet , our mission is to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Data Science plays a critical role in delivering on that mission, helping us better understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that best meet their needs. We’re growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) to join us as a foundational member of our new team. You’ll help shape and advance our machine learning capabilities across consumer personalization, predictive modeling, and performance marketing, with a real voice in how we work from day one. Together, we’re building an inclusive, supportive team culture where we lift each other up and succeed together to drive business impact across the organization. In this role, you will lead the development of production-grade machine learning solutions that power some of NerdWallet's most critical business decisions. From predicting customer lifetime value and scoring incoming leads in real time to developing recommendation engines that connect consumers with the right financial products, your work will have a direct impact on how we acquire, engage, and monetize our customer relationships. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with deep expertise in applied machine learning, production ML systems, and the Databricks ecosystem. As a foundational member of the team, you’ll partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Analytics to translate complex business problems into scalable ML solutions, while helping establish the technical standards and best practices for machine learning across NerdWallet. Where you can make an impact: Build Predictive Models That Drive Business Growth Lead the end-to-end development of advanced machine learning models focused on customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion propensity, lead quality, and revenue optimization. Translate model predictions into actionable signals that improve marketing investment decisions, customer acquisition efficiency, and long-term profitability. Advance Personalization & Recommendation Systems Develop recommendation and ranking models that identify the most relevant financial products for individual consumers based on their needs, behaviors, and predicted propensity to engage or convert. Explore and implement approaches such as propensity modeling, learning-to-rank, and next-best-product recommendations to improve customer engagement and cross-sell opportunities. Collaborate with Product and Marketing to integrate predictive intelligence into consumer experiences and personalized communications. Establish Best-in-Class ML Practices Leverage Databricks and MLflow to develop, train, deploy, monitor, and manage machine learning models at scale. Establish robust DS practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, feature engineering, automated training pipelines, model monitoring, and reproducibility. Define standards for model performance, reliability, retraining, and production readiness, including monitoring for data drift and model degradation. Design and evaluate experiments to measure the incremental business impact of deployed models and continuously improve their effectiveness. Serve as a technical leader within Data Science, mentoring other practitioners, influencing architectural decisions, and elevating engineering and modeling standards across the organization. Your experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of developing and deploying ML solutions that drive measurable business impact. Deep, hands-on experience with Databricks, including building and managing production machine learning workflows using MLflow and the Databricks ML ecosystem. Please note: this role requires hands-on Databricks experience specifically, and experience with similar platforms is not a substitute. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with extensive experience using modern machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. Strong understanding of supervised learning, predictive modeling, classification, regression, ranking, and model evaluation techniques. Practical experience designing scalable batch and/or real-time inference systems, with an understanding of latency, reliability, and performance trade-offs. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, modular code design, and CI/CD practices for machine learning. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous technical initiatives from problem definition through deployment and business impact measurement. Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, conversion improvement, customer lifetime value, and marketing efficiency. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing technical direction and working effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Where: This is a remote position and a person can be located anywhere in Canada (with the exception of Quebec). NerdWallet is proud to be a remote-first company! We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family. What we offer: Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?) Monthly Healthcare Stipend Rejuvenation Policy – Vacation Time Off + You will receive the official public holidays in your province Paid sabbatical for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge and pursue their interests Monthly Wellness Stipend, Wifi Stipend, and Cell Phone Stipend Work from home equipment stipend Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too) Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people) RRSP with a 4% match. Eligible one month after hire. Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar NerdWallet is committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, so all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. #LI-DNI

At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the peopl
items.description: Product Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . We are looking for an Analytics Engineering Manager II, Core Data Science to help improve the quality and velocity of data science at Pinterest. You will shape the future of the people-facing and business-facing products we build by creating rock-solid data foundations and tooling, and by leading a high-performance team that partners closely with our Core Data Science organization. What you'll do: Build, inspire, and grow a high-performance, diverse team of analytics engineers with an inclusive culture. Develop best practices for instrumentation and experimentation and communicate those to product engineering teams. Build and prototype AI tools and analysis pipelines iteratively to provide insights at scale while developing comprehensive knowledge of data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed. Use AI to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and iteration—drafting pipelines, exploring approaches, and automating repeatable documentation and QA—while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness and quality. Work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers to build tools and processes that enable self-service of key datasets, insights, and metric investigations. Contribute to comprehensive documentation of tools and datasets, and drive the strategy for better data quality and data democratization within Pinterest. Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights, collaborating with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest. What we're looking for: 6+ years of experience working with data in a fast-paced, data-driven environment, including experience managing engineers. Ability to manipulate large data sets with high dimensionality and complexity; fluency in SQL (or other database languages) and a scripting language (Python or R), including nested data structure manipulation, windowing functions, query optimization, and data partitioning techniques. Experience conducting workflow orchestration and ETL/ELT with huge, complicated datasets and handling DAG data dependencies. Consistent track record of supplying analytics solutions to existing teams, with the ability to take open-ended goals and scope them into defined, impactful objectives. A team player able to partner with cross-functional leadership to quickly turn insights into actions, and an accountable operator who proactively identifies project opportunities amid competing priorities. Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve speed and quality in your day-to-day workflow, with a strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work (testing, source-checking, data validation, peer review). High integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI, and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables. Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. Desired but not required: Experience in automation, anomaly detection, or infrastructure/workflow optimization. Experience building internal tooling to maximize engineering velocity. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/month and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. #LI-REMOTE #LI-AG8 At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise. Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here . US based applicants only $177,185 — $364,795 USD Our Commitment to Inclusion: Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online wi
items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Munich, Frankfurt or Berlin About the Role We are seeking an exceptional new-logo builder to join our Named Sales Team as a Senior Named Account Executive . Your primary mission is new logo acquisition within an assigned portfolio of high-potential Named accounts: identifying, pursuing, and closing net-new business with leading enterprises across Germany. You will create opportunities where no existing relationship or active buying process exists, open doors at executive level, and establish Cloudflare as a long-term platform partner. Developing and expanding a limited number of existing Named accounts will be secondary to winning new business. The ideal candidate combines a relentless prospecting mindset with sophisticated enterprise sales execution, executive presence, and genuine technical fluency, enabling credible engagement from the boardroom to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure. As a Senior Named Account Executive, you will own your territory and assigned Named-account portfolio end-to-end. You will prioritise accounts based on their potential, build multi-year account plans, generate high-quality pipeline through direct outreach and the wider partner ecosystem, and orchestrate virtual deal teams across Customer Engineering, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, and Partners. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, challenge customers’ thinking with a strong point of view, and consistently exceed new logo and new business targets. In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will actively leverage AI tools across prospect research, account prioritisation, executive outreach, account planning, meeting preparation, and pipeline management—using them as a genuine force multiplier in how you hunt and sell. Responsibilities New Logo Acquisition within Named Accounts: Own the identification, pursuit, and closure of net-new business across your assigned Named-account portfolio as the primary focus of the role. Build pipeline proactively through personalised executive outreach, disciplined prospecting, ecosystem engagement, partner channels, industry networks, and referrals. Create demand rather than relying on inbound opportunities, and consistently bring significant new logos onto the Cloudflare platform. Named Account Planning: Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans for priority net-new targets and selected existing Named accounts. Identify whitespace, business initiatives, power structures, buying processes, competitive dynamics, and potential entry points. Continuously assess account potential and concentrate time and resources on the accounts and opportunities with the greatest potential for platform-wide adoption. Executive Relationship Management: Build trusted relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level, often starting without an existing Cloudflare presence. Develop broad, multi-threaded executive networks within target Named accounts and act as a trusted advisor by bringing relevant market insight, a compelling point of view, and clear business value—not simply responding to RFPs. Complex Sales Cycle Leadership: Lead sophisticated enterprise sales processes from initial engagement through contract signature. Navigate technical, security, legal, procurement, financial, and executive buying centres simultaneously. Establish clear mutual action plans, maintain control of deal momentum, qualification, and next steps, and advance opportunities with precision and appropriate urgency. Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect’s technology environment, including cloud strategy, network architecture, security posture, application landscape, data sovereignty, regulatory requirements, and AI infrastructure. Map Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, positioning comprehensive platform adoption rather than isolated point solutions. Virtual Deal Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, Legal, Partners, and other specialists to win complex, high-value opportunities. Align resources around a differentiated strategy, proactively remove blockers, and deliver a consistently excellent prospect experience throughout the sales cycle. AI-Powered Sales Execution: Use AI tools deliberately and consistently to improve the quality and velocity of your sales execution. Apply them to account research and prioritisation, hypothesis development, stakeholder mapping, personalised executive outreach, meeting preparation, competitive analysis, pipeline inspection, and follow-up. Continuously experiment with new ways to make your Named-account management and customer engagement sharper and more effective. Digital Transformation & AI Positioning: Serve as a credible partner to enterprises navigating digital, cloud, security, and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping infrastructure, compliance, security, and competitive dynamics. Position Cloudflare capabilities—including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads—as strategic enablers of customers’ long-term transformation agendas. Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Build and maintain sufficient high-quality pipeline across your Named-account portfolio to consistently achieve ambitious new business targets. Deliver accurate, evidence-based account and opportunity forecasts to sales leadership, with clear visibility into qualification, deal status, risks, stakeholder alignment, and required actions. Apply rigorous inspection and honest judgement across long and complex enterprise sales cycles. Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Lead complex commercial and contractual negotiations with confidence and discipline. Construct compelling, outcome-linked value propositions tied directly to each customer’s business objectives. Secure commercially strong, sustainable agreements while protecting long-term customer value and Cloudflare’s position as a strategic platform partner. Trusted Advisor & Organisational Contribution: Share field intelligence, competitive insight, and winning practices openly across the German and wider international teams. Contribute to Cloudflare’s understanding of the German Named-account market, partner with colleagues to improve execution, and elevate the performance of those around you through coaching, collaboration, and example. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 8+ years of experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with a substantial track record of consistently exceeding multi-million-euro new business and quota targets in a Named account or comparable enterprise account environment . Proven enterprise hunter: Demonstrated success opening and closing large, complex net-new accounts, including opportunities created without inherited relationships, inbound demand, or an active customer-initiated buying process. A consistent history of personal pipeline generation within assigned account portfolios, including disciplined prospecting, executive outreach, account-based selling, and effective use of partners and industry networks to access senior decision-makers. Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), Connectivity, Developer Platforms, and Edge Computing, with the ability to engage credibly with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and senior infrastructure leaders. Proven ability to understand complex enterprise IT architectures and map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures, connecting technical differentiation to measurable business outcomes and platform-wide adoption. Demonstrated success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles across procurement, legal, information security, technical, financial, and executive buying centres. Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context, such as prospect research, account prioritisation, executive outreach personalisation, account planning, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, or pipeline management. You can explain specifically how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective. Familiarity with AI transformation trends and their infrastructure, security, sovereignty, and compliance implications, with the ability to position Cloudflare’s AI platform capabilities as strategic enablers for large enterprises. Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to challenge senior stakeholders constructively, hold the room, and connect platform capabilities to board-level priorities. Advanced negotiation skills and a track record of closing six-figure and multi-million-euro net-new transactions involving complex commercial, technical, and contractual requirements. Proficiency in Salesforce CRM and disciplined pipeline management; MEDDPICC methodology strongly preferred, with evidence of applying rigorous qualification rather than simply documenting it. Experience selling into large German or DACH enterprises, particularly regulated or complex industries such as financial services, insurance, automotive, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, energy, telecommunications, or critical infrastructure. Familiarity with requirements such as GDPR, NIS2, and sector-specific regulation is advantageous. Proficiency in modern sales, productivity, business intelligence, and AI platforms, such as Salesforce, Tableau, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365. Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, competitive, and resilient, with the persistence to build opportunities within Named accounts over long sales cycles and the judgement to disqualify opportunities that are unlikely to convert. Ability to travel as required to engage with customers, partners, and internal teams across Germany and internationally. Language Skills: Executive-level fluency in German and English, with the ability to prospect, present, negotiate, and build trusted C-suite relationships in both languages. Compensation For Germany-based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €169,000–€232,000 . This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan. Equity: This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Your career progression is merit-based; the more you learn, take initiative, and consistently deliver quality work, the faster you can level up. items.summary: Headquarters: NYC, Remote Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.
