The Obsidian Security platform gives unified visibility into every human and machine identity, app, and integration across their SaaS estate, detects identity-based…
items.description: Obsidian Security is a global leader in cyber security protecting the SaaS and non-human identity layer modern enterprises run on — from Salesforce and Snowflake to the AI agents now deployed inside them. The Obsidian Security platform gives unified visibility into every human and machine identity, app, and integration across their SaaS estate, detects identity-based and supply chain attacks in real time, and enforces least-privilege access before it's exploited. Trusted by major Fortune 500 companies T-Mobile, Workday, Snowflake, and S&P Global, Obsidian ranked No. 95 on the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, growing nearly 1000% from 2021–2024 — helping CISOs turn an unmonitored attack surface into one they can govern with confidence. Obsidian has also been recognized by Forbes as America's Best Startup Employers in 2026. In August 2026, Obsidian raised $85 million in Series D financing led by Crescent Cove Advisors, with participation from existing investors including Greylock Partners, Menlo Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, IVP, Wing Ventures, and GV — pushing Obsidian's valuation to $1.1 billion, crossing into unicorn status. Obsidian is using the funding to deepen its R&D in agentic AI security and extend its platform as the standard for governing what AI agents can access and do inside third-party applications. With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and fresh capital from its Series D behind it, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness. About the Team We’re building a new Service Operations function within Customer Success to modernize how we structure, access, and act on customer data. This is a foundational role: you’ll be the primary consumer of the data built and owned by Business Systems, transforming it into automated reporting and AI-assisted tools that enable customer health tracking, streamline QBRs and EBRs, and provide executives with clear visibility into customer outcomes. About the Role Own the reporting and automation layer for Customer Success — translate stakeholder needs for account health, QBR/EBR decks, and executive dashboards into field-level requirements, then build the reporting and automation on top of the Customer Success data mart. Default to AI-first workflows — shape the roadmap for both deterministic (data plumbing) and non-deterministic (AI/LLM-driven) automation that surfaces customer insights, health checks, and recurring reports, replacing manual, ad hoc work wherever possible. Automate recurring Customer Success workflows beyond reporting , including renewal/adoption tracking, repetitive support tasks like ticket triage and diagnostics, and cross-platform automation that connects support tools (e.g., Zendesk) with systems like Salesforce, Slack, and the data warehouse to cut down manual handoffs. Help define a secure, auditable data access model for Customer Success workflows, in partnership with Business Systems and Security (who own implementation). Maintain data quality and documentation for Customer Success data sources, flagging gaps, inconsistencies, or governance issues as you find them. Partner across Business Systems, Product/Engineering, and Customer Success (TAM and Support) to shape how data flows into the reports and tools people use every day. About You An AI-first approach to problem-solving — you default to evaluating where agentic or LLM-driven workflows can replace manual, ad hoc reporting rather than reaching for another one-off script or dashboard. Hands-on experience with Databricks (or a comparable modern data platform), including querying, data modeling on governed marts, and metric/semantic views. Familiarity with Python or another scripting language for data transformation and automation. Strong communication skills — able to translate ambiguous business reporting needs into concrete data requirements. Experience with Salesforce data and/or customer success platforms (e.g., Totango, Zendesk, Gainsight) is a plus. Understanding of data access governance and security best practices, particularly around customer-tenant data. Comfortable operating with ambiguity, partnering directly with engineering/business systems teams that own the broader data warehouse. Experience designing or implementing automation for technical support workflows and cross-platform integrations (e.g., ticket triage, diagnostics, connecting support tools to Salesforce, Slack, or data platforms using an established integration platform) is a plus. Experience with cybersecurity, SaaS security, or a technical B2B SaaS environment is a plus, but not required. Employee Benefits Our competitive benefits packages are designed to support our employees' well-being, both at work and at home. Our US based employees enjoy: Competitive compensation with equity and 401k Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage Flexible paid time off and paid holiday time off 12 weeks of new parent or family leave Personal and professional development resources For more details on our US benefits, or for information on our international benefits, please see here . Pay Transparancy Please note that the base pay range is a guideline and for candidates who receive an offer, the base pay will vary based on factors such as work location, as well as the knowledge, skills and experience of the candidate. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for equity awards and may be eligible for sales commission or incentive compensation based on the role or function within the company. At Obsidian, we are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and hire for talent, passion, and compassion. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to submit satisfactory proof of identity and legal authorization. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact accommodations@obsidiansecurity.com Information collected and processed as part of any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Obsidian’s Applicant Privacy Policy . Base Salary Range $120,000—$130,000 USD Employee Benefits: Our competitive benefits packages are designed to support our employees' well-being, both at work and at home. Our US based employees enjoy: Competitive compensation with equity and 401k Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage Flexible paid time off and paid holiday time off 12 weeks of new parent or family leave Personal and professional development resources For more details on our US benefits, or for information on our international benefits, please see here .

items.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: We are seeking a dynamic Data Import & Reporting Analyst to join our customer success team. This role bridges the gap between data services and business intelligence. Your mission is two-fold: first, you will orchestrate smooth data migrations, helping new clients transition their historical data (reservations, guest profiles, inventory) from legacy systems to Cloudbeds. Second, you will act as a reporting strategist, coaching clients on how to leverage Cloudbeds’ reporting features to extract meaningful insights, track KPIs, and drive data-backed business decisions from day one. Our Data Services Team: We are a collaborative, remote-first team energised by solving complex data puzzles and transforming technical transitions into seamless, empowering experiences for hoteliers worldwide. We thrive on cross-functional teamwork, blending analytical precision with a passion for client education so that no property is left in the dark. If you love deep-diving into spreadsheets just as much as celebrating a client’s "aha!" moment when their data reporting clicks, these are your people. Working Shift: Monday - Friday 10PM - 7AM GMT+8 What You Bring to the Team: Lead Data Migrations: Act as the primary technical advisor guiding new clients through the smooth transition of historical data (reservations, guest profiles, inventory) into Cloudbeds. Execute Data Manipulation: Extract, clean, map, and validate client data from CSV/Excel formats to ensure flawless system uploads. Drive Technical Troubleshooting: Proactively identify and resolve formatting discrepancies or system mismatches before clients go live. Empower Clients Through Coaching: Train properties on how to build, customize, and automate operational and financial reports within the Cloudbeds platform. Ensure Data Integrity: Guide clients through post-migration audits to validate accuracy across financial histories and occupancy metrics. Advise on Best Practices: Consult with property managers on key performance indicators (KPIs) to help optimize their daily operations from day one. What Sets You Up for Success: Hospitality Tech Background: Direct experience working with Hotel Property Management Systems (e.g., Cloudbeds, Opera, Mews, Protel, or similar software). Client-Facing Expertise: A proven track record in onboarding, implementation, or Tier 2/3 technical support with a natural ability to teach and guide users. Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency: Power-user skills in Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data cleaning). Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of basic data management principles, data mapping, parsing, and root-cause error analysis. Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision when handling sensitive historical, financial, and guest records. Remote-First Readiness: Highly tech-savvy with cloud-based workflows and equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for video coaching sessions. Professional proficiency (verbal and written) in Spanish Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional): BI & Analytics Familiarity: Prior experience working with business intelligence dashboards or advanced financial reporting structures. Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas. What to Expect - Your Journey with Us Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary. Learn more online at cloudbeds.com Cloudbeds Awards : Winner – Hotel Management Software | HotelTechAwards (2026) Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026) Overall Top 10 Hotelier's Choice | HotelTechAwards (2026) Finalist – Property Management Systems (PMS) & Channel Managers | HotelTechAwards (2026) Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024) Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024) Discover our Benefits: Remote First, Remote Always PTO in accordance with local labor requirements Fully Paid Parental Leave Home office stipend based on country of residency Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com. Cloudbeds will provide an American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter where needed as a reasonable accommodation for the hiring process. To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Cloudbeds. Staffing, recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Cloudbeds does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Cloudbeds employees, or any other company location. Cloudbeds is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

items.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, UK)
items.summary: Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote) Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafa
items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote) Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland. The Opportunity About our platform Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely. The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads. About the Infrastructure group We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable. You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group. We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen. How we work Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on. Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it. What You'll Be Doing Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth. Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity. Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them. Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours. Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads. Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves. Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response. Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it. We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards. What Makes You a Great Fit Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to. Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production. A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall. The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on. Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety. You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space. Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow. Bonus Points For Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to. Building self-service infrastructure for application teams Running observability for a production platform at scale Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA" In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is £ 107,077 - £128,493 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. #LI-Remote *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/grafana-labs-engineering-manager-grafana-infrastructure-remote-uk

Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity. Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them. Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours. Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads. Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves. Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response. Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it. We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards. What Makes You a Great Fit Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to. Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production. A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall. The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on. Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety. You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space. Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow. Bonus Points For Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to. Building self-service infrastructure for application teams Running observability for a production platform at scale Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA" In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is € 96,846 - €116,215 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. #LI-Remote *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. items.title: Head of Product - Beamable

Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game sys
items.description: Product Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated. Beamable is part of FIRY , a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR , our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it. About the Role Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios. As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth. Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively. Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win. Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case. AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform. Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews. Key Competencies Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set. Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom. Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down. AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity. Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after. 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time. Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator. Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 10+ years in product management, including experience as a product lead or head of product owning a product line’s strategy — not just a feature set. Proven experience in gaming live-ops — either running live games or building tools for teams that do: events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, or player data. Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup as a solo or founding PM, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities. At least one AI or ML-driven feature shipped to production and used by real customers. Demonstrated data fluency: SQL, product analytics tools, and a track record of living with business metrics over time to drive decisions. Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred. Experience taking a product from early access to public launch preferred. Total Starting Compensation including Base + Bonus + Equity: $212,625 + Bonus + Equity Location: Remote - CA, NV, or NY Travel Requirement: Less than 10% Why Beamable Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more. Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, virtual therapy sessions, and more. Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays. Beamable embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with applicable fair chance ordinances. #GC-Remote #GC-1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/firy-head-of-product-beamable

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Business Development and Client Engagement Manager Salary: Php 80,000 to Php 100,000/month Working Hours & Conditions: AU Working Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is dedicated to transforming lives through high-quality, person-centred care. Operating across Western Australia, we deliver trusted Supported Independent Living (SIL), community participation, and specialised support services designed to empower participants and foster long-term independence. Our culture is rooted in genuine empathy, rigorous service standards, and collaborative community partnerships. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an ambitious, results-driven Business Development and Client Engagement Manager to spearhead our market expansion and drive participant intake across Perth and the wider Western Australian region. Reporting directly to leadership and collaborating closely with the Operations Manager, you will operate as an "A+ Hunter"—proactively identifying referral opportunities, cultivating strategic relationships across the disability and healthcare ecosystems, and managing the end-to-end conversion cycle. This is an autonomous, high-impact field sales role where your commercial acumen, networking capability, and relentless follow-through will directly translate into sustainable service growth and full SIL occupancy. RESPONSIBILITIES: Strategic Outreach & Referral Generation Conduct outbound prospecting to identify and secure referral streams across Perth and Western Australia. Build and nurture strong professional relationships with Support Coordinators, Psychosocial Recovery Coaches, hospital discharge teams, allied health professionals, mental health networks, and justice-transition services. Coordinate and attend targeted field visits and partner meetings to pitch service offerings and establish sustainable intake pipelines. Lead Management & Conversion Respond rapidly to participant enquiries (acknowledgement within 2 business hours) and drive structured lead qualification. Organise and facilitate participant intake meetings, service suitability assessments, and accommodation inspections. Collaborate closely with the Operations Manager to verify service capacity, staffing logistics, and participant matching before finalising agreements. Draft accurate service proposals, quotations, and service agreements, driving follow-ups to achieve prompt execution. SIL Vacancy Management & Service Expansion Actively market and promote available Supported Independent Living (SIL) vacancies across relevant networks. Coordinate property viewings, engage with families and decision-makers, and support safe, appropriate participant compatibility matching. Pinpoint emerging service demands in regional and metropolitan catchments to advise on future property and service expansions. Pipeline Governance & Reporting Maintain daily, end-to-end data integrity within the CRM—logging contacts, meeting outcomes, lead stages, and next actions. Deliver weekly pipeline updates, conversion analysis, and field-activity schedules every Monday by 10:00 AM. Produce monthly performance reviews evaluating channel effectiveness, onboarding numbers, SIL occupancy, and revenue growth. Experience: Minimum of 2 years of professional B2B business development, sales, or client acquisition experience within Australia. Industry Acumen: Sound working knowledge of the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), SIL funding mechanisms, and the broader WA human services/health landscape. Clearances: Valid (or ability to immediately obtain) NDIS Worker Screening Check, National Police Clearance, and Working with Children Check (WWCC). Preferred Proven track record in a similar growth role within an NDIS registered provider, healthcare provider, or community organisation in Western Australia. An established network of active contacts among Perth-based Support Coordinators, LACs, hospital social workers, and community mental health organisations. Experience navigating complex participant matching and intake workflows within Supported Independent Living (SIL) settings. What You’ll Bring A True Hunter Mindset: Highly proactive and self-motivated, with the grit to initiate cold outreach, build pipelines from scratch, and turn conversations into committed placements. Relationship Focus: Exceptional interpersonal communication and presentation skills that build immediate credibility with industry professionals, participants, and support networks. Accountability & Commercial Rigour: Clear focus on activity metrics and KPIs, taking personal ownership of pipeline velocity, follow-up cadence, and conversion outcomes. Ethical Boundary Management: A consultative, compliant approach that balances commercial targets with participant safety, operational capacity, and strict person-centred care principles. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-business-development-and-client-engagement-manager-dayshift-remote

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://wisetechglobal.com Company Description WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers. Job Description A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business. WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place. Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit. This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. What You'll Do Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high. Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level. Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals. Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics. Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities. Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission Qualifications What You'll Bring 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred). Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software. Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles. Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges. Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently. Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Additional Information When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture. Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics. Before You Apply From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations. Compensation: USD 100000 - USD 150000 - yearly To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wisetech-global-e2open-us-area-sales-director-cpg

With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers. Job Description A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business. WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place. Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit. This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. What You'll Do Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high. Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level. Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals. Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics. Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities. Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission Qualifications What You'll Bring 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred). Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software. Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles. Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges. Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently. Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Additional Information When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture. Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics. Before You Apply From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations. Compensation: USD 100000 - USD 150000 - yearly To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wisetech-global-e2open-us-area-sales-director-cpg-washington

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany Munich Als Head of Lead Generation verantwortest du den Aufbau, die Performance und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Leadgenerierung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Cold Calling. Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung aus der telefonischen Kaltakquise mit, weißt, wie erfolgreiche Outbound-Prozesse funktionieren, und kannst dieses Wissen an ein Team weitergeben. Du bist sowohl operativ als auch strategisch tätig: Du führst und trainierst unsere Cold Caller, optimierst Prozesse und erschließt bei Bedarf weitere Kanäle zur Leadgenerierung. Dabei bist du technisch affin, prozessverliebt und nutzt gerne technische Lösungen und KI-Tools, um unsere Leadgenerierung smarter und effizienter zu gestalten. Tools wie Zapier, Claude Code, Enrichment Tools wie Lusha und Co sollten dir bekannt sein! Aufgaben Operatives Cold Calling: Du kontaktierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden telefonisch, qualifizierst Leads und vereinbarst Termine für unser Sales-Team Teamführung und Training: Du führst unser Cold-Calling-Team, schulst neue Mitarbeitende und coachst das Team, um die Gesprächsqualität und Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern Strategische Leadgenerierung: Du entwickelst unsere Leadgen-Strategie weiter, definierst Ziele und optimierst bestehende Prozesse. Weitere Outbound-Kanäle: Du steuerst und entwickelst zusätzliche Kanäle wie LinkedIn-Outreach, Cold Mailing und Paid Ads Performance-Management: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und sorgst für die Erreichung individueller und gemeinsamer Ziele Prozessoptimierung: Du entwickelst Leitfäden, Standards und Best Practices für eine effiziente und skalierbare Leadgenerierung und nutzt Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, um unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren Qualifikation Was du dafür mitbringen musst: Mindestens 1 Jahr praktische Cold-Calling-Erfahrung Erfahrung in der B2B-Neukundengewinnung Erfahrung in der Führung und im Training von Vertriebsteams Du bist technisch affin, prozessverliebt und bringst Erfahrung mit KI-Tools mit und hast Lust, diese gezielt im Vertrieb einzusetzen Idealerweise Erfahrung mit weiteren Outbound-Kanälen Strategisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität Benefits Betriebliche Weiterbildung Flexible Arbeitszeiten 100 % Remote - Arbeite von überall! Unsere Vision? Wir bauen das beste Livetrainingsangebot für Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Markt auf! Aktuell haben wir zu viele hungrige Interessenten und brauchen dringend High-Performer, die sich unsere Mission anschließen wollen. Wenn du also hungrig auf mehr bist und massiv wachsen möchtest - bewirb dich noch heute bei uns! Art der Stelle: Festanstellung, ggf. Freelance To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lotaro-head-of-lead-generation-remote-m-w-d

items.title: Statistician
items.summary: Role Title: Statistician Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is selecting Statistician to contribute expert knowledge to a customer project focused on advancing data-driven solutions.
items.description: Role Title: Statistician Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is selecting Statistician to contribute expert knowledge to a customer project focused on advancing data-driven solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Clean, preprocess, and structure complex and messy datasets using advanced statistical software (such as R, Python, SAS, or Stata). Apply and document basic descriptive and inferential statistical analyses to uncover trends and patterns in real-world data. Develop clear and compelling data visualizations to illustrate key findings and support model development. Contribute expertise in dataset annotation, labeling, or enrichment to enhance the quality of AI model training datasets. Draft concise, well-organized written summaries of methods, analyses, and results for a non-technical audience. Collaborate asynchronously with project stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and improve deliverables through effective written and verbal communication. Continuously identify data quality issues, provide actionable recommendations, and document solutions for handling dirty or incomplete data. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field. Expertise in cleaning and preparing complex, messy (“dirty”) datasets with R, Python, SAS, or Stata. Proficiency in basic descriptive and inferential statistical techniques, including hypothesis testing and regression analysis. Strong programming skills in Python or R for statistical analysis, data manipulation, and visualization. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to non-technical and technical audiences with clarity and precision. Experience working with large, unstructured, or noisy datasets across a variety of domains. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on detailed documentation and collaboration in remote environments. Originally posted on Himalayas

You'll be part of modernizing the EHR platform to enable better data access, patient experience, and quality of care for 567 tribes, 37 states and over 600 medical facilities. Our work depends on a ServiceNow Developer joining our team to support the Indian Health Service (IHS) Electronic Health Records Modernization (EHRM) program. As a ServiceNow Developer supporting the IHS EHRM program, you will be responsible for setting up and maintaining the ServiceNow instance for the program. This position is fully remote! HOW A SERVICENOW DEVELOPER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT: Develops and maintains cloud solutions, supporting cloud systems, plans and strategy Develop, configure, and maintain custom reports, dashboards (using PA/Reporting), and KPIs for ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Request) to visualize performance and trends Build and customize applications, workflows, Business Rules, UI Policies, and Client Scripts within ITSM modules Work with end users, stakeholders, and management to define and create reports, dashboards, and data analysis products Customize user interfaces, forms, and workflows to align with business needs Script and automate processes, data imports, and report generation to enhance efficiency Connect ServiceNow with other systems using REST/SOAP APIs Perform platform health checks, upgrades, and user/role management Ensure solutions adhere to ServiceNow best practices, minimize technical debt, and support platform governance Provide end-user support and troubleshooting for issues related to integrated processes and platform functionality Participate in IT-related technical processes reviews, postmortems, and continual process improvement Maintain current ServiceNow and industry certifications, while obtaining additional certifications REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE: Bachelor’s degree (additional work experience can be used in lieu of a degree) 2+ years of experience supporting cloud deployment and maintaining cloud solutions Strong proficiency with ServiceNow ITSM and SPM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Service Catalog) and platform capabilities Proficiency with ServiceNow Reporting and Performance Analytics (PA) Exposure to ServiceNow's data management tools such as Import Sets, Transform Maps, and the CMDB Experience with REST/SOAP APIs Understanding of ACLs, UI Policies, and Business Rules Ability to analyze requirements, troubleshoot issues, and develop effective solutions Ability to identify, understand, document, and create functionality aligning with customer value streams Organizational and time management skills while working in a rapid software development environment Ability to identify and learn new technologies quickly Must be able to obtain a Public Trust Level 5 clearance. Ability to travel up to 25% of the year, if needed. DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE: 4+ years of relevant analyst experience. Experience supporting federal contract program manager. Experience with additional ServiceNow modules beyond ITSM and SPM Experience with ServiceNow Automated Testing Framework Excellent organizational and time management skills; ability to manage frequently changing priorities of competing importance. Ability to communicate and interact effectively with internal/external teams including key stakeholders and customers. Ability to produce high-quality documentation that contributes to the overall success of our program. Good communication skills for collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Effective analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills GDIT IS YOUR PLACE: ​Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home. 401K with company match. Comprehensive health and wellness packages. Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career. Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications. Cutting-edge technology you can learn from. Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holidays. #IHSJobs #GDITFedHealthJobs The likely salary range for this position is $97,750 - $132,250. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range. Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 Travel Required: 10-25% T elecommuting Options: Remote Work Location: Any Location / Remote Additional Work Locations: Total Rewards at GDIT: Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most. Our Identity Verification Process: As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development. items.description: Product Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . We are looking for a motivated Performance Test Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in performance testing, scripting, and analyzing application performance. You will work closely with Performance Engineers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to identify performance bottlenecks, validate application scalability, and ensure our products meet performance and reliability expectations. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts using tools such as Apache JMeter, Locust, and K6 . Conduct load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing for APIs and web applications. Execute weekly release performance tests , analyze results, identify regressions, and report findings to ensure release readiness. Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks, response-time degradation, and resource utilization issues. Monitor application and infrastructure metrics, including CPU, memory, throughput, latency, and error rates. Collaborate with development teams to investigate performance issues and validate fixes. Develop and maintain reusable performance testing scripts and test data. Participate in integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines. Document test scenarios, execution results, and performance findings. Support performance regression testing as part of regular release cycles. Work with senior engineers to improve performance testing frameworks and processes. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on performance testing experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools. Good understanding of performance testing concepts, including load testing, stress testing, throughput, latency, and concurrency. Experience testing REST APIs and understanding HTTP/HTTPS protocols. Basic programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or JavaScript. Ability to analyze performance results and troubleshoot application issues. Familiarity with Linux environments and basic command-line utilities. Understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with K6, Locust , or other modern performance testing frameworks. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, and basic cloud networking concepts. Basic understanding of Kubernetes and Docker , including containers, pods, deployments, and resource utilization. Experience with UI test automation using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing and development tools , including using generative AI to create test scripts, analyze results, troubleshoot failures, or improve automation efficiency. Basic knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts. Familiarity with Git commands and repository management , including branching, committing changes, creating merge requests, and resolving basic merge conflicts. Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar automation pipelines. Basic understanding of databases, SQL queries, and application architecture. Familiarity with distributed systems and microservices. What We’re Looking For A curious engineer who enjoys troubleshooting and understanding how systems behave under load. Someone comfortable analyzing data and communicating technical findings. A proactive team player who can work independently on assigned testing activities while collaborating with senior engineers. An engineer interested in leveraging AI and automation to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity. A strong desire to learn new performance engineering tools, technologies, and methodologies. What we offer you: Outstanding Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs. Wellness benefits to help you focus on what’s most important. “Take What You Need” time off policy. Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode. Generous 401k match to help save for your future . Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day. Compensation Transparency In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Veracode provides compensation transparency for roles based in the United States. Click here to view our compensation ranges by grade. Please note, specific compensation may be influenced by various factors including candidates experience, education, and work location. Job Grade: Career Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-performance-test-engineer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: El Salvador URL: http://thrivedigital.com Performance Strategist (Demand Gen) Job Details Role: Performance Strategist (Demand Gen) Department: Performance Job Location: Remote (El Salvador) Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours) Compensation: $41,000 - $50,000 USD + Benefits Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply! About Thrive Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar. Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon. Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together. The Opportunity This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat. The Role Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes. Working Within Our Values: At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required. Your focus of responsibilities will be: Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers. Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators. Client : Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes.
