items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) About the Role: Maven is seeking a Manager, Payments & Reconciliation to lead the end-to-end financial operations and reconciliation framework across our enterprise and consumer programs. Reporting into the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team, you will architect a robust, scalable payment integrity program. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of payment funding, from accurate invoicing and money movement oversight to complex account reconciliation, while partnering with Product/Engineering to build automated financial controls that ensure operational excellence at scale. As a Manager, Payments & Reconciliation at Maven, you will: Oversee the end-to-end movement of payment funds across Maven’s Enterprise and Consumer programs, ensuring transaction accuracy, timely disbursement, and integrity across the full funding pipeline, including fee-for-service claims payments. Own client and payer invoicing for payment funding programs and the timely reconciliation of complex claims funding account transactions and balances, ensuring paid claims tie back to funding. Monitor clinic, provider, and fee-for-service claims payments against contracted rates and timeliness standards, identifying overpayments, underpayments, and SLA gaps, and partnering with operations to resolve root causes and recover funds. Manage Maven's floated benefit funding program, including tracking outstanding float balances, driving timely recoupment from clients and payers, and escalating aging exposure to Finance. Lead cross-functional root cause analyses on financial discrepancies and drive continuous process improvements that prevent billing errors, optimize cash flow, and increase the accuracy and scalability of the payments and invoicing function. Partner with Finance during the month-end close process, including supporting the preparation of detailed bank reconciliations, owning reporting deliverables and assisting with analyses around collections risk. Act as the financial subject matter expert for Client Success, equipping CSMs with detailed reconciliation insights and structural solutions to resolve billing disputes and optimize the client funding experience. Act as the business owner for funding tools, collaborating with Product and Engineering to design application enhancements, resolve bugs, and automate financial workflows. Establish and uphold strong internal controls and accountability standards to support audit readiness and financial compliance. We’re looking for you to bring: 6+ years in revenue cycle management, financial analysis, or payment operations, with direct experience in payment funding, fee for service, settlements, reconciliation, claims funding accounts or healthcare payment operations strongly preferred. Demonstrated readiness to lead a team, with experience mentoring junior staff, managing cross-functional workstreams, or standing in for a manager. Extensive experience in account reconciliation and using AI (e.g. Claude) and data tools (e.g., Looker) to identify financial patterns and drive business decisions. A proven track record of "creating order from chaos" by building sophisticated financial processes in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments. Strong technical aptitude and experience partnering with Product/Engineering to resolve bugs and build automated financial fail-safes. Proficiency in Asana, Jira, SQL, and Looker to manage financial workflows, track technical tasks, and report on program health. The base salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset. Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. This role is open to candidates in remote locations with a strong preference for San Francisco, CA; secondary locations include Seattle, WA and New York, NY. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-manager-payments-reconciliation

Sunday-to-Thursday (including Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, and Thur), 9AM-to-5PM. This position will rotate through the above work schedules quarterly, i.e., work in one rotation schedule for 3 calendar months, and then move to the other rotation schedule for another 3 calendar months. This is an exciting opportunity in our Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) department at Natera (a global leader in precision medicine and genomics testing), to provide critical data analytics support for our lab production operations. As a Senior Data Analyst for Lab Production Support in our DSPE Extended-Hours Support (ExHS) team, you will work in the Weekend Shift team (following the above two rotation schedules). You will have the opportunity to apply innovative data analytics solutions, directly support the most cutting-edge medical diagnostics and genomics applications, and make real & immediate impact to patients and healthcare providers, by providing timely & accurate data analysis support to Natera's production laboratories, as well as for other key business needs. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Technical Execution and Infrastructure Deliver timely data support to Lab Operations teams, unblock production issues, and improve patient results turnaround times. Apply statistical techniques to analyze complex datasets, diagnose operational issues, and support data-driven decision-making. Perform exploratory data analysis, identify trends, and work with stakeholders to interpret findings and drive continuous improvement. Design and implement automated solutions for recurring data analysis and production support workflows, improving operational efficiency and scalability. Extract, transform, and analyze data to generate actionable insights that support lab production operations and business decisions. Document analytical processes, best practices, and insights to ensure consistency and knowledge transfer across teams. Process Improvement Develop and optimize solutions for efficient data retrieval and scalable performance on large and/or complex datasets. Learn and acquire operational efficiencies on new technologies and solutions developed by other DSPE teams. Train and coach junior team members on new technologies, procedures, and guidelines/best practices. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Lab Operations and Product teams to identify process issues, assist with root cause analysis, and provide product support. Represent the Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) team in stakeholder meetings. Effectively and correctly escalate encountered issues to other DSPE teams. QUALIFICATIONS: Masters degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Operational Research, or other related fields. Minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience. Minimum 3 years of experience working in a highly regulated environment (e.g., CLIA and/or FDA compliant settings). Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, extraction, querying in production support roles. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Working knowledge of the business processes and requirements of diagnostic laboratories. Knowledge of molecular biology, genetics, genomics, and/or bioinformatics is a plus. Proficient in data analysis and statistical techniques. Proficient in Python and SQL development. Working knowledge of Snowflake platform and cloud technologies. Strong understanding of statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, central limit theorem, time series analysis, anomaly detection, and regression modeling. Good documentation practices and coding style. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience using version control systems such as GitHub or GitLab for managing code and collaboration. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong integrity. The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations. Remote USA $113,600 — $142,000 USD OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! For more information, visit www.natera.com . Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @ natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. items.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. The Lead, Employee Data Analyst owns the integrity of our employee data. You ensure the data in Workday and connected systems is accurate, consistently used, and ready for every People program, serving as the upstream data foundation for People Analytics. You will set the data quality strategy, lead complex data loads and testing, and guide the Employee Data Analyst. This position requires onsite attendance two times per week What You’ll Do Data Quality Strategy and Governance Define and implement a Workday data quality audit strategy, aligning with key partner teams (People Analytics, IT, Finance, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition). Oversee routine data audits in line with the strategy, set standards, and escalate and resolve systemic issues. Partner across teams, including People Analytics, to own a data dictionary that defines how Workday fields are used, who owns them, and the related processes. Maintain Workday security groups and role-based permissions, run periodic access audits, and document changes in line with the governance model. Maintain the Workday Reporting Catalog in partnership with IT. Data Loads and Integrations Perform routine and complex EIB data loads into Workday, including high-risk and high-volume loads. Collect, clean, and validate data across Workday, Culture Amp, Greenhouse, and other tools so it is accurate and consistently used. Troubleshoot data integration issues and system changes in partnership with IT. Cyclical Programs and Projects Prepare data ahead of cyclical programs such as performance reviews, promotions, and open enrollment. Conduct Workday functional testing for releases, configuration changes, and new projects. Participate in business requirements gathering for People systems and process projects, representing data and reporting needs. Automation and Continuous Improvement Use Workday Agents and/or agents built with Claude to automate routine data quality checks and audits. Continually look for ways to optimize and scale work through process improvements, AI/ML, or agents. Privacy and Leadership Handle sensitive employee data with the highest level of confidentiality and in line with privacy requirements. Guide, review, and develop the work of the Employee Data Analyst. What You’ll Bring 5–7 years of experience in HRIS, HR data management, or people operations, with deep hands-on Workday experience. Advanced proficiency with Workday EIBs, including complex loads, and strong knowledge of Workday HCM data structures. Experience designing or running data quality audits and data governance (for example, data dictionaries and field ownership). Experience with Workday functional testing and with report writing or reporting catalogs. Experience with, or strong interest in, using AI agents or automation to improve data processes. Strong communication and partnership skills with People, IT, and business teams. Sound judgment, discretion, and attention to detail when working with confidential data. Bachelor’s degree in information systems, HR, a quantitative field, or equivalent experience. Nice to Have Workday certification (HCM, Reporting, or Integrations). Experience with Culture Amp and Greenhouse integrations. SQL, Python, or other data tooling. Experience with Workday Prism Analytics. Experience in a global or distributed environment. Get to Know Us: At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together. Equal Opportunity Employer: Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

Candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role San Francisco The Partner Strategy team works directly with Databricks' Partnerships leaders to drive operational scale across our Consulting and Systems Integrator ecosystem, in an extremely high-growth environment. We give our stakeholders and senior leadership the insights, tools, and decision criteria to shape proactive, effective, data-driven programmatic strategies. We're looking for a Strategy Manager to be the business partner to the VP of Global Systems Integrators. It's a critical, high-visibility role built on two elements: Strategic business partner to GSI leadership. You partner with the VP of Global Systems Integrators to set the strategy and medium- to long-term goals for the business. Then you lead the execution: building scalable processes, building consensus, and running programs end to end. You're the connective tissue across Partnerships, Sales, Product, Finance, Data, Legal, Commercial, and the broader GTM org. You invest the time to know the SI landscape, our GSI partners, and the SI operating model. A highly technical, analytical operator. You love working with data. You're AI-fluent, and you use cutting-edge AI and data tools for analysis, problem solving, visualization, and automation. You'll own the executive analyses and deep dives that turn SI performance trends into action. You must be able to run the day-to-day operating cadence with rigor, while also stepping back to bring a strategic point of view the leader hasn't asked for yet. You will report to the Director of Partner Strategy & Operations. This is a unique opportunity to help shape and scale the strategy behind one of Databricks' most important growth engines: our Global Systems Integrator partnerships. The impact you'll have Be the strategic business partner to the VP of Global Systems Integrators. Know the GSI partners, programs, and numbers well enough to surface risks, opportunities, and recommendations before you're asked. Own the operating cadence for the GSI business. Run the rhythm of the business and give clear visibility into performance against targets. Lead executive analyses and deliverables, such as board materials and QBRs, with a point of view, not just data. Define and run high-impact cross-functional programs end to end, from strategy through execution. Turn data and voice of the field into a better SI strategy. Dig into GSI performance trends and drive them to action that improves SI strategy and programs. Guide annual GTM planning for the GSI business: FY and long-range modeling, KPI setting, and HC planning. What we look for Relevant experience. 7+ years of strategy & operations experience (e.g., Enterprise SaaS, top-tier strategy consulting, investment banking, business operations). Business ownership. You have the leadership and confidence to partner with VP-level GTM stakeholders like you own the business, not support them from the sidelines. Relentless problem solving. You love to analyze, set priorities, and solve complex problems. You dig deeper to find root causes, and you're not afraid to ask questions. AI and technical fluency. AI and data tools are part of your daily workflow for analysis, problem solving, data visualization, and automation. You keep learning and growing your skills, and you know the common GTM tech stack (Databricks, SFDC, Tableau, SQL, etc.). Comfort with ambiguity. Our GSI business is growing fast in scope and complexity, so things won't always be clean or easy. You embrace that challenge and are excited to build for scale. SI ecosystem fluency. You understand the Systems Integrator, GTM, or sales/partner operating model, and you have the judgment to weigh tradeoffs within it. What this role isn't Not an order-taker or reporting function. You're expected to partner with the VP of Global Systems Integrators to set strategy and own outcomes, not wait for tasks to be assigned. Not a pure strategy role. You'll lead execution of the initiatives you help define. Building processes and consensus is part of the job, not optional. Not a static environment. The GSI business keeps expanding in scope and complexity. If you prefer clean, well-defined problems, this isn't the right fit. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before. items.description: Why Socure? Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Automation team. You will play a critical role in designing and building scalable data platforms and pipelines that power Socure’s identity verification products and analytics. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong passion for solving real business problems with data, and combines deep hands-on data engineering expertise with strong ownership. What You'll Do • Design and build batch and streaming data pipelines to support automated data ingestion, ML feature engineering and analytics across multiple product domains. • Own end-to-end delivery of complex, ambiguous data initiatives, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and documentation. • Develop and evolve the data platform to support large-scale data processing using modern cloud-native technologies. • Automate data operations (validation, quality checks, alerting, backfills, and recovery workflows) to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. • Optimize cost, performance, and reliability of data workloads. • Partner closely with cross-functional teams (Data Science, Product, Engineering) to understand requirements, translate them into technical solutions. • Evaluate and adopt new technologies (new processing engines, storage formats, orchestration tools, GenAI-assisted ingestion) to keep the platform modern and efficient. What You Bring • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, building and maintaining production-grade data platforms and pipelines. • Strong programming skills in general-purpose language (such as Python or Scala) for data processing, and SQL for data analytics. • Deep experience with distributed data processing frameworks, such as Apache Spark, including performance tuning and optimization. • Proven experience building data solutions using services on AWS (EMR, Lambda, s3, etc). • Strong understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts, including partitioning, schema design for large-scale datasets. • Experience operating and supporting production pipelines, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and improving reliability over time. • Solid foundation in software engineering practices, including version control, CI/CD, testing strategies, and code review. • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with streaming or near-real-time data processing (Kafka, Kinesis, etc). • Hands-on experience with data orchestration tools (Airflow, Step Functions, etc). • Familiarity with modern data platform patterns such as Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh, and large-scale data sharing across teams. • Experience with prompt engineering using modern GenAI, Large Language Models (LLM). • Experience mentoring other engineers and contributing to engineering-wide standards, best practices. As a note; Socure cannot provide sponsorship now or in the future for this role. Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. items.description: About Wurl , LLC. At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue. In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150+ person startup as well as the stability of a high-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024. We’re looking for a Data Engineering Intern to assist in enhancing the quality and reliability of our data collection platform. This role will provide hands-on experience in data engineering, security operations, and cloud infrastructure, with guidance from experienced engineers and cross-functional teams. What You’ll Do Review and validate ETL processes for completeness and data consistency. Improve our data-consistency validation processes by migrating legacy and semi-manual validation processes to our new framework. Assist in developing monitoring and alerting systems for data consistency and configuration integrity. Work with the data team to analyze, streamline, automate, and improve ETL processes, including ingestion of new data sources. In particular, you’ll focus on improving the automation of our data-related channel-launch processes. Contribute to internal documentation and knowledge bases related to ETL, validation, and alerting procedures. Learn about and contribute to large-scale, cloud-native data systems. What You Bring Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field. GPA of 3.5 or more Familiarity with SQL and Python. items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to bring robust, integrated data models and products to life within the VTEX Ads platform. You will be the data modeling reference point across the entire Ads ecosystem—advertisers, publishers, events (clicks, views, impressions), and performance—translating these domains into reliable data for product, client, data science, and business teams. From requirements gathering to production pipelines in our Lakehouse, you will ensure scalability and reliability for decisions that sustain the platform's operations and revenue. ABOUT THE TEAM You will join Campaign Intelligence, the newest team in our Data & Analytics organization, focused on the engine behind the VTEX Ads platform: pacing, target ROAS, budget forecasting, and auction optimization. We are responsible for structuring and serving this platform's data, giving product, data science, business teams, and clients reliable visibility into advertisers, publishers, and Ads performance—accelerating data-driven decisions on a global scale. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build and maintain robust, scalable analytical models in AWS Cloud. Participate in defining data requirements alongside product and technology teams. Develop ingestion, transformation, and data modeling pipelines using the VTEX data platform. Support stakeholders with technical and analytical topics, translating needs into practical solutions. Monitor performance, optimize queries, and ensure reliability across SQL and Python environments. Contribute to spreading best practices and driving the evolution of the data stack. WHO YOU ARE Hard Skills Familiarity with metrics and concepts from ad tech/martech platforms (campaign performance, attribution, ROAS/CTR/CPC, etc.). Experienced in data modeling for large-scale analytics. Experienced with databases and data warehouses on AWS (Athena, Trino, Redshift, etc.). Advanced SQL, Spark, and Python, along with query optimization skills. Hands-on experience with orchestration and data transformation tools (Airflow, Python, Spark, EMR, Glue, etc.). Knowledge of AWS Cloud environments (preferably Redshift, S3, Glue, EMR). Practical experience using GenAI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT) to accelerate daily development, debugging, and documentation. Knowledge of semantic data layers (dbt semantic layer, LookML, Cube, etc.). Knowledge of software engineering is considered a plus. Soft Skills Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences. Analytical mindset, strong problem-solver, and results-oriented. Autonomy, proactivity, and comfort working in dynamic, iterative environments. Collaborative mindset with a strong focus on organizational impact. Curious mindset, always seeking to understand the "why" behind problems before proposing solutions. About VTEX VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024). Founded in the year 2000, VTEX has a history of being unstoppable. Completely against the odds, VTEX is leading a high-tech industry and positioned above market giants. We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees scattered across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia. For more information, visit www.vtex.com . At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together. BENEFITS Annual profit-sharing program and equity eligibility; Health, dental, and life insurance with national coverage provided by VTEX; Annual budget for professional development in Tech; Language development incentive program (English, Spanish, Portuguese); Flexible meal allowance; Extended parental leaves; Child-care assistance; Flexible work schedule and remote-first culture; Financial assistance to build your work-from-home setup; Wellness program; Free shipping on 1000+ VTEX stores #LI-Remote

items.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: We are seeking a dynamic Data Reports & Insights Analyst to join our Customer Success team. This role bridges the gap between data services and business intelligence. As a Reports & Insights Analyst, you'll help Cloudbeds customers turn raw operational and financial data into decisions they can act on. You'll build, analyze, and optimize reports across our PMS reporting suite, troubleshoot discrepancies before they become customer frustrations, and coach hoteliers on how to read metrics like ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, and channel performance with confidence. Every report you refine and every question you answer on calls or emails, directly shapes how hospitality businesses understand their own performance and grow their revenue. Our Team: Data Services sits at the intersection of hospitality expertise and reporting technology, working to make sure Cloudbeds customers never have to guess what their numbers mean. Reporting to your lead, you'll join a team that partners closely with Product, Onboarding, Support, and Customer Success to keep improving how customers access and interpret their data. It's a hands-on, collaborative group that treats every reporting question as a chance to make the platform and the customer's business a little smarter. What You Bring to the Team: You've spent time inside hotels and property management systems; you understand hospitality data isn't just numbers on a screen; it's occupancy, revenue, and guest behaviour telling a story. You're comfortable with advanced Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas) and have worked with BI or reporting tools involving dashboards, filters, and custom reports. You communicate clearly in written and verbal English, translating technical reporting concepts into plain language for customers who may not be data experts. You're detail-oriented, adaptable to shifting priorities, and genuinely enjoy solving the puzzle when a report doesn't add up. What Sets You Up for Success: Hospitality Tech Background: Direct experience working with Hotel Property Management Systems, channel managers and similar systems Client-Facing Expertise: A proven track record in onboarding, implementation, or Tier 2/3 technical support with a natural ability to teach and guide users. Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency: Power-user skills in Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data cleaning). Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of basic data management principles, data mapping, parsing, and root-cause error analysis. Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision when handling sensitive historical, financial, and guest records. Remote-First Readiness: Highly tech-savvy with cloud-based workflows and equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for video coaching sessions. Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional): Multilingual Capabilities: Professional proficiency (verbal and written) in Spanish or Portuguese. BI & Analytics Familiarity: Prior experience working with business intelligence dashboards or advanced financial reporting structures. What to Expect - Your Journey with Us Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary. Learn more online at cloudbeds.com Company Awards : Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025) Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025) Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024) Top 10 People’s Choice (2024) Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024) Discover our Benefits: Remote First, Remote Always PTO in accordance with local labor requirements Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month Fully Paid Parental Leave Home office stipend based on country of residency Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com . items.summary: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: • Equity Research • FP&A • Corporate Finance • Accounting or Audit • Investor Relations • Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: • Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours • Location: Remote, worldwide • You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP • Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: • You will work on questions about real US public companies.
items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience. Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects. Build smarter systems through AI and automation Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT. Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency. Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes. Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work. Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance. Think like a product owner Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements. Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact. Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs. Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience. Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning. Collaborate across Typeform Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues. Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members. Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation. What you'll bring Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company. ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management. Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations. Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian. Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools. Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity. Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management. Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution. A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Nice to have Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations. Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems. Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms. Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting. Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. About the Opportunity We are looking for a dedicated and proactive Senior Business Development Manager to join our team. As a Business Development Manager, you will play a key role in expanding our network of Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and affiliates in Poland. This role is responsible for those partnerships from a to z. What You'll Be Doing Expert Knowledge: Demonstrate extensive knowledge of the trading and crypto industries, including market trends, regulations, and key players, to make informed business decisions. Affiliate Recruitment: Proactively search for and attract new affiliates, VIP traders and trading/crypto communities and influencers, fostering strategic partnerships to enhance our network. Results-Driven Approach: Implement strategies and campaigns to drive measurable results, focusing on creating content, increasing trading volume, acquiring new users, and promoting active transactions through affiliate channels. Relationship Building: Cultivate and maintain strong business relationships with VIP and affiliates, ensuring their needs are met and aligning their strategies with our business objectives for mutual growth. Partnership Expansion: Initiate and participate in meetings with partners, exploring opportunities to expand cooperation and strengthen existing relationships, both locally and internationally. Collaboration with Product Team: Collaborate closely with colleagues from the product department, providing valuable market insights to optimize product offerings and attract qualified users. Competitor Analysis: Stay updated on competitors' advantages and industry trends, utilizing this knowledge to refine our strategies, maintain a competitive edge, and capitalize on market gaps. What We Look For In You Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent years of experience) Fluency in English and Polish Proven experience in affiliate operations, performance marketing, or BD within crypto, finance, or trading - especially in Poland Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using data/BI tools (e.g. Excel, SQL, Tableau/Looker or similar) to driving decisions Solid understanding of affiliate marketing operations: tracking, attribution, campaign management Highly organized, process-oriented, and comfortable owning operational details end-to-end Goal-oriented mindset, with a focus on measurable results and continuous optimization Understanding of financial market dynamics and regulations relevant to the Polish/Eastern European region Nice to Have Experience working across time zones and cross-cultural teams Bonus points if you have previously worked at a crypto exchange, trading company, CFD broker! Passionate about blockchain technology and the crypto trading space Knowledge of other Eastern European languages is a strong plus Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events More that we love to tell you along the process! items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: El Salvador URL: http://teamswell.co Description MARKETING ASSSISTANT (Part time) Teamswell is a high-growth nearshore outsourcing company working for US companies. Our mission is to help small and medium-sized US businesses grow and become more profitable by having access to highly engaged, skilled, and experienced talent at a fair price, and to generate career opportunities for bilingual professionals in Latin America with fair compensation and opportunities for professional and personal growth. We are currently looking for a Marketing Assistant to support marketing and communications efforts. This is a hands-on execution and ownership role for a seasoned marketing professional who can independently manage campaigns, create high-quality content, and help elevate brand presence across all channels. This is not an entry-level role - we are looking for someone who understands marketing strategy, executes at a high level, and brings ideas forward - not just deliverables. In Teamswell, every team member has an instrumental role and impact on the success of our business and our clients’ success, so we seek to have highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced work environment, who are intelligent, eager to work hard, reliable, and able to communicate effectively with all levels of an organization. Our Marketing Assistant will possess the skills and experience required, as well as a positive attitude and ability to solve complex problems and work in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. We value people who are good communicators, quick learners, scrappy about finding creative solutions to problems, and conscious of their work quality. We expect all our team members to deliver excellence in both technical expertise as well as in their everyday relationships with their team. RESPONSIBILITIES Execute marketing campaigns for chapter events, programs, and initiatives from concept through delivery Develop and manage content across social media and digital platforms Create newsletters, flyers, PDFs, and promotional materials that are polished, engaging, and on-brand Manage and grow social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn Design high-quality visual content using Canva or equivalent tools Maintain and update website content as needed (event pages, announcements, resources) Use CRM/marketing tools such as Pipedrive to support campaign execution and tracking Monitor engagement and performance metrics and provide insights and recommendations Ensure full brand consistency across all communications and platforms Requirements REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS Proven experience in digital marketing, content strategy, and campaign execution (not hobby-level or occasional freelance work) Strong portfolio of work across social media, email marketing, and digital campaigns Advanced design capability using Canva or similar tools (high-quality flyers, PDFs, and social creative) Hands-on experience managing brand accounts on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn Demonstrated ability to create and execute email newsletters and campaign content Experience with CRM or marketing automation tools (Pipedrive preferred, or equivalent such as HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, etc.) Comfort managing and updating website content (WordPress or similar platforms) Exceptional attention to detail and strong sense of brand consistency Excellent communication skills with a proactive, solution-oriented approach Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/teamswell-marketing-assistant

items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA- For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. Smartsheet is looking for a Principal Pricing Program & Operations Manager to join our Pricing & Packaging team. This individual connects pricing strategy to execution. Our pricing analysts and strategists develop the research, analysis, and recommendations. You will take those recommendations and drive them to realization: building the plan, aligning the stakeholders, and landing the change across Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing, Legal, Billing, and Operations. You will work with guidance from the Sr. Director of Pricing & Packaging, but you will own the execution of your programs end to end. You will keep multiple initiatives moving at once, adapt quickly as priorities shift, and make sure that what we decide in the pricing team is what customers and the field actually experience. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong B2B SaaS pricing acumen with the discipline of a program and operations leader. You understand why a pricing change is the right call, and you know how to get it done. You will report to our Sr. Director of Packaging & Pricing, and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer. What You Will Do: Program execution Own the end-to-end execution of pricing and packaging initiatives, from the handoff of a recommendation through launch and post-launch measurement. Examples include new packaging constructs, list price changes, rate card updates, AI and new-capability monetization, and customer migrations. Build and manage detailed program plans, timelines, dependencies, risk registers, and RACI structures across multiple concurrent projects. Translate pricing recommendations into clear requirements and action plans for the teams that implement them, including Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Finance, Billing, Legal, Marketing, and Customer Success. Run program cadences, including stand-ups, steering committees, and executive updates. Surface risks and decisions early, and escalate with clear options and trade-offs. Re-plan and re-prioritize quickly as business priorities, market conditions, and leadership direction change. Cross-functional leadership and communication Build trusted partnerships across the organization and secure stakeholder buy-in, often without direct authority. Write clear, executive-ready documents, including program briefs, decision memos, launch plans, FAQs, and status reports. Present program status, outcomes, and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership. Partner with Sales Enablement and Marketing to develop field-facing materials such as pricing guides, discounting guidelines, talk tracks, and training, so that changes are understood and adopted. Pricing operations and governance Operationalize pricing policy by partnering with the right cross-functional partners for critical changes to prices, discount guidelines, approval workflows, quoting and CPQ configuration, billing and systems changes, and exception handling. Contribute to pricing governance, including intake, prioritization, decision rights, approvals, and deal-desk escalation paths. Build repeatable playbooks, templates, and processes for pricing launches, migrations, and changes so the team can scale. Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, and Business Systems to ensure pricing changes are accurately reflected in systems, reporting, and forecasts. Analytics and performance tracking Define success metrics for each program and track post-launch performance, including ARR, NRR, ARPU, attach rate, price realization, discount levels, and migration performance. Use data to monitor adoption, identify issues, and recommend corrective actions or follow-on work. Work with the pricing team to understand the research, models, and assumptions behind each recommendation so you can execute with context and flag when results diverge from the plan. Support competitive pricing and packaging monitoring that informs ongoing program decisions. You Have: 7 to 10+ years of experience in pricing, monetization, revenue operations, strategy and operations, program management, or a related commercial function, with at least 5 years in B2B SaaS pricing or monetization. A proven track record of driving pricing or packaging changes to execution in a multi-product, multi-segment SaaS business, not only recommending them. You can point to launches or migrations you delivered and the outcomes they produced. Strong program and project management skills. You are skilled at managing complex, cross-functional initiatives with many dependencies and stakeholders. Operations experience, such as pricing operations, deal desk, revenue operations, sales operations, or business operations, and familiarity with how pricing flows through quoting, billing, and finance systems. Strong business and pricing strategy acumen. You understand value metrics, packaging architecture, unit economics, and how pricing decisions affect revenue, margin, and customer experience. Excellent verbal and written communication. You can distill complex topics into clear narratives for executives, partners, and the field. Comfort working cross-functionally, with the ability to influence and build consensus across teams with different priorities. The ability to adapt and pivot quickly. You stay organized and focused as priorities change, and you bring structure to ambiguity. Analytical skills sufficient to size impacts and track results: advanced Excel or Sheets, working knowledge of SQL, and experience with a BI tool (e.g., Tableau). A collaborative, low-ego working style that fits Smartsheet's culture. Nice to Have: Experience in work management, collaboration, productivity, or analytics SaaS, ideally with AI-enhanced products. Experience launching or operationalizing pricing for AI features. Exposure to PLG plus enterprise "hybrid GTM" environments. Experience managing customer migrations, grandfathering, or renewal-based price changes. Hands-on familiarity with CPQ, billing, and CRM systems and the processes that surround them. Background in pricing consulting or strategy consulting. Experience with pricing governance forums. Global pricing experience (US plus EMEA/APAC). Current US Perks & Benefits: Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay) Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific) Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity. US Base Salary Pay Range $201,250 — $238,750 USD Get to Know Us: At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position : Digital Marketing Specialist Salary : Up to $2,400 NZD per month Working Hours & Conditions : Part-Time, aligned with New Zealand business hours Work Arrangement : Remote ABOUT THE COMPANY: An innovative B2B SaaS platform serving the Allied Health clinic sector. By integrating directly with leading Patient Management Systems, their software provides branded, web-based patient intake forms and dedicated check-in kiosk solutions that streamline clinical operations and enhance the patient journey. Backed by an established strategic roadmap and marketing leadership, the organization is scaling its multi-channel footprint and market reach. ROLE OVERVIEW: Working directly alongside the Marketing Growth Lead, the Marketing Specialist acts as the core tactical execution engine for the brand. This role bridges high-level strategy and day-to-day operations by managing content output, web pages, email nurture sequences, and multi-channel campaigns. It is designed for an autonomous, execution-focused professional who excels at turning strategic roadmaps into measurable pipeline momentum in a fully remote setup. RESPONSIBILITIES: Content Production: Write, edit, and publish blog posts, resources, and case studies that speak to Allied Health clinic owners and practice managers. Manage the content calendar and maintain a consistent publishing cadence. Website & Landing Pages: Build and update pages in Webflow — including landing pages, feature pages, and conversion-focused content — to support campaigns and improve the buyer journey. Email Marketing: Set up and execute email campaigns including nurture sequences, onboarding flows, and re-engagement campaigns using our email marketing platform. Campaign Execution: Deploy and monitor marketing campaigns across B2B channels, including paid acquisition when required. Social Media: Maintain a consistent, high-quality presence across relevant social platforms. Plan, create, and schedule posts that build awareness and drive traffic. Review & Reputation Campaigns: Drive customer review campaigns to build social proof on relevant platforms. Performance Tracking: Monitor campaign and channel performance, pull basic reporting, and flag what's working and what isn't. You don't need to be a data analyst, but you should be comfortable reading dashboards and reporting on key metrics. Momentum Building: Proactively identifying the next steps needed to keep our growth roadmap on track. What We're Looking For Execution Focus: You love the "doing" part of marketing and take pride in seeing a plan come to life. Eye for design: Good instincts for layout, imagery, and visual consistency. You can create professional-looking assets without needing a designer for every task. Self-Starters: You are proactive and comfortable working independently within a defined strategy. Reliability: You are a consistent "engine" who can be counted on to deliver high-quality work. Comfortable with marketing tools like Slack, Webflow, G2, Gartner, Plausible Analytics, Google ecosystem B2B Experience: Ideally some marketing experience in the B2B SaaS landscape. Highly Desirable Direct background or familiarity with the Allied Health, healthcare, or clinic management software industry. Tech-forward mindset with an appetite for adopting modern AI tools to augment workflows, accelerate output, and maintain high operational leverage. Prior experience managing multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-part-time-digital-marketing-specialist

items.description: EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION WILL REQUIRE U.S. CITIZENSHIP. Responsibilities: Designing data workflows, pipelines, and pathways to support ETL/ELT, while ensuring data-quality and exchange of sensitive information across AWS cloud and on-prem environments. Implementing systems engineering principles to ensure the reliability, scalability, and maintainability of data layer systems, including backup and recovery strategies Architecting, deploying, and operating data streaming technologies (Kafka, Redpanda, Kinesis, etc ) on Kubernetes with an emphasis on declarative definitions to reduce complexity in day-2 operations Working with a platform team to implement best practices for configuration management, security, and performance optimization within Kubernetes and AWS environments Working with a platform team to automate infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, and scaling using tools such as Terraform working with cybersecurity SMEs to incorporate best practices and techniques to defend our data layer against potential threats Ensuring that our data layer systems are compliant with industry and DoD regulations, standards, and best-practices Staying up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies related to Kubernetes, containerization, and data engineering Travel Expectations/Requirements: 6-10 times per year The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization.
