items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The Bundeswehr is one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. With our Celonis for Defense & Security initiative, presented at the Munich Security Conference 2026, we offer a sovereign and trusted platform that integrates data across systems and optimizes military processes along the entire value chain. This means higher operational readiness through optimized logistics and faster maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) cycles, greater resilience through end-to-end supply chain transparency, and faster IT modernization by connecting existing systems with modern AI applications. Building on our data analysis solution Metropolis , we also help connect information from a wide range of sources into a comprehensive situational picture , enabling faster and better-informed decisions during the actual mission . To drive this forward, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Bundeswehr . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows the Bundeswehr from the inside: how its structures work, how processes in logistics, maintenance or procurement really run, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships across the Bundeswehr and the defense ecosystem, and to position Celonis as a long-term partner for its digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of the armed forces into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships across the Bundeswehr – Army (Heer), Navy (Marine), Air Force (Luftwaffe) and Cyber and Information Domain Service (CIR) – and its ecosystem, e.g. the Federal Ministry of Defence (BMVg), the Federal Office of Bundeswehr Equipment, Information Technology and In-Service Support (BAAINBw) and BWI GmbH. Engage with decision-makers from leadership, logistics, procurement, IT and digitalization. Translate operational challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact, e.g. in logistics and supply, MRO and materiel readiness, supply chain resilience, procurement and IT modernization. Bring the voice of the Bundeswehr into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate defense procurement and tender processes (e.g. VSVgV, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and defense IT providers. Represent Celonis at public sector and defense events and conferences. The Qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the Bundeswehr , e.g. as an officer or civilian employee, ideally in a leadership role and/or in logistics, procurement, IT, digitalization, planning or organizational development. A solid network within the Bundeswehr and a deep understanding of its organization, decision-making and budget and planning processes (e.g. the procurement process CPM). First-hand understanding of the process and data challenges in areas such as logistics, materiel readiness, maintenance or procurement. A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role. Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way. Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new. Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and English. Familiarity with defense procurement processes is a strong plus. Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset. Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins #LI-SS6 What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celonis-account-executive-public-sector-germany-defense-bundeswehr

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote (USA) WHO WE ARE Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 12 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. Our brand is built on trusted emotional connection, empathy, and consistency in how we show up for people every day. We are woven into everyday moments of people’s lives, becoming part of their routines, their self-expression, and their confidence. We are defined not just by what we make, but by how we make people feel and the relationships we build over time. Our north-star values are to be Human, Curious, Playful, and Helpful. We are driven by a shared mission to become the Most Loved Lifestyle Brand in the World. THE ROLE Glossier is seeking a senior brand consultant to help accelerate the brand's cultural & PR relevance, creator ecosystem, and breakthrough marketing initiatives during a pivotal period of growth and evolution. This is not a traditional influencer marketing or PR role. We are looking for a strategic, creatively minded marketer with exceptional cultural instincts, deep relationships across creators, talent, and emerging cultural communities, and a track record of turning ambitious brand ideas into meaningful cultural moments. Working closely with the CMO and cross-functional marketing leadership, this person will bring an outside-in perspective, fresh thinking, and an entrepreneurial approach to building brand heat, relevance, and advocacy. The immediate focus will be an upcoming launch, alongside longer-term brand-first opportunities. Key Areas of Focus New Launch: Develop and help activate an earned-first cultural amplification strategy that extends the launch beyond traditional product marketing. Identify unexpected creators, talent, cultural partners, and communities that can bring the campaign to life in distinctive ways. Originate high-impact brand moments, partnerships, and activations designed to drive conversation, organic advocacy, and cultural relevance. Lead press strategy in partnership with external agency partners Collaborate with Brand Marketing, Influencer, PR, Social, and Creative teams to integrate opportunities into the broader launch plan. Creator & Cultural Ecosystem Help build Glossier's approach to creators and influencers beyond transactional partnerships toward meaningful, sustained brand relationships. Identify emerging cultural voices and tastemakers across beauty, fashion, art, music, lifestyle, and adjacent communities. Develop opportunities for creator-led storytelling, organic advocacy, and innovative collaborations that reinforce Glossier's unique place in culture. Partner with the existing influencer team to elevate strategic thinking and unlock new opportunities. Brand-First Marketing & Narrative Partner with CMO on reinforcing Brand Narrative Collaborate with the CMO and Brand Marketing leadership to identify opportunities for Glossier to show up in culture beyond traditional product launches. Develop compelling ideas for cultural collaborations, community initiatives, and brand platforms that deepen emotional connection with consumers. Explore how Glossier's flagship stores can become meaningful cultural and community destinations through relevant partnerships and programming. Bring fresh inspiration, emerging trends, and outside perspectives to challenge conventional beauty marketing approaches. Compensation for the role will be determined based on permissible, nondiscriminatory factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and experience. Click here to view the candidate privacy policy under FAQs We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (“EEO”) Employer. It has been and will continue to be a fundamental policy of Glossier not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, partnership status, domestic violence victim status, sexual orientation, age, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, unemployment status or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state and/or local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, training, working conditions, transfer, job assignment, benefits, layoff, and termination. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glossier-senior-brand-consultant-pr-influencer-contractor

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Indonesia URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/3k8LqqAdNwD4WEpupmsk52/jobs-at-mash Location: Malaysia preferred Format: 12-month fixed-term contract Market: Japan Experience: 1–3 years Language: Fluent Japanese and professional English We’re looking for a driven Japanese-speaking Sales Development Representative to support the growth of a publisher acquisition programme across Japan. This role focuses on identifying and qualifying prospective partners, building relationships within the local app developer, gaming and web publisher community, and creating opportunities for the wider sales team. You’ll combine research, outreach and relationship-building with a strong understanding of the local market. You’ll be comfortable starting conversations, learning how digital businesses generate revenue, and helping prospective partners understand the value of digital advertising and monetisation solutions. This is a great opportunity for someone with 1–3 years of early-career sales or business development experience who wants to build their career within technology, apps, gaming and digital advertising. Lead Generation & Qualification Research prospective app developers, gaming studios, web publishers and digital businesses across Japan using Salesforce, Google Play Store, App Store, market intelligence platforms, industry events and networking. Qualify leads using agreed criteria and relevant business and app metrics, including downloads, active users, revenue and growth potential. Build and maintain an organised pipeline of prospects, keeping lead status and activity accurate in Salesforce. Stay close to local market developments and identify emerging businesses, trends and opportunities worth pursuing. Outreach & Relationship Building Execute targeted outreach through email, phone, social media, events and community engagement. Build relationships with prospective publishers and developers and understand their business, growth priorities and monetisation needs. Communicate relevant programme and product value propositions clearly and confidently. Support publishers in understanding digital advertising and monetisation solutions and connect them with the right internal expertise where required. Build credibility within Japan's app developer, gaming and publisher communities through thoughtful and culturally appropriate engagement. Sales & Market Support Schedule and coordinate qualified meetings between prospective partners and the wider sales team. Support preparation for prospect meetings and presentations by gathering relevant company, market and performance information. Track outreach activity, meetings, pipeline progress and conversion in Salesforce. Share recurring prospect feedback, local-market insights and emerging opportunities with regional stakeholders. Support relevant industry events, networking opportunities and partner engagement initiatives. About You Ideally 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, sales development, business development, partnerships or another client-facing commercial role. Fluent Japanese with strong written and verbal communication skills, alongside professional working English. Strong understanding of Japanese business culture and the confidence to engage professionally with local stakeholders. Curious about technology, apps, gaming, digital advertising and the wider publisher ecosystem. Strong research skills with the ability to identify promising businesses and assess commercial opportunities. Confident starting conversations with prospective clients and developing relationships over time. Comfortable working with data and using simple insights to support outreach and commercial conversations. Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple prospects, follow-ups and priorities. Proactive, self-motivated and eager to learn. Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is useful. Previous experience within technology, apps, gaming, AdTech, media or digital businesses is valuable but not essential. Please note Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can’t get back to every one of you, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mash-sales-development-representative-japanese-speaking

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Karnataka, India URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app Role - Video Editor Work Location - Work From Home About Lokal : In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital About the role : We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact. Key Responsibilities: ● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers. ● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention. ● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts). ● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design. ● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life. ● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable. ● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates. ● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience. What You’ll Bring ● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content. ● Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar. ● Any Bachelor’s degree. ● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos). ● Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics. ● Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills. ● Language proficiency: Strong command over two languages minimum — English and TTMK— both written and spoken, to bring cultural nuance and flexibility in writing. ● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines ● Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks. Why This Role Is Exciting : ● Create high-impact video content that drives engagement and brand growth. ● Collaborate with cross-functional creative and marketing teams. ● Shape storytelling across platforms with visible, meaningful impact. Why Join Us: ● Create impactful video content ● Competitive pay and growth opportunities ● Work with a creative, fast-moving team We’ll Get Along If You… ● Take ownership of your edits and creative output ● Enjoy storytelling and visual creativity ● Are comfortable with fast-paced timelines and feedback ● Believe in learning, experimenting, and continuous improvement We’ll Get Along If You… ● Take ownership of your edits and creative output ● Enjoy storytelling and visual creativity ● Are comfortable with fast-paced timelines and feedback ● Believe in learning, experimenting, and continuous improvement To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lokal-app-video-editor-ttmk-eaze

We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports. Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns. Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates. Marketing Automation & CRM Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows. Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign . Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs. Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation. Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization . Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools . Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns . Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms. Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) . Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. They are building a company around a larger belief: learning should help people develop the skills, knowledge, and understanding to become who they want to be. They are now entering their commercial growth stage, with creative agencies as the first priority market, followed by independent trainers, learning consultants, and other organizations. Company Culture Our client is looking for someone who can think strategically and execute independently in an early-stage startup environment. If you are resourceful, take ownership, and enjoy working closely with founders and a collaborative team, this is the right place for you. Benefits of working with our client include: Founding-level marketing ownership with direct collaboration with the founder and business development lead Purpose-driven, multicultural team in a fast-scaling EdTech environment Benefits Remote work PTO Weekends off USD monthly payment Growth opportunities Job Description Our client is hiring a Marketing Lead to build and execute their marketing strategy, establish market awareness, generate qualified leads, and support revenue growth. This is a hands-on role, not a purely strategic one. You will work closely with the founder, the business development lead, and existing marketing contributors, and you will be expected to move from strategy to execution independently. The ideal candidate is a creative, commercially minded, resourceful builder who understands both brand storytelling and customer acquisition. You will be especially valuable if you understand how creative agencies operate, what drives their purchasing decisions, and how the platform can help them expand their capabilities and create new value for their clients. Responsibilities Develop and execute the B2B marketing and go-to-market strategy, beginning with creative agencies Build demand-generation campaigns that produce qualified leads and sales opportunities Develop compelling brand positioning, messaging, and content that differentiates the company in the market Showcase the flagship product through campaigns, demonstrations, and real-world use cases Collaborate closely with business development on targeting, campaigns, sales materials, and pipeline growth Manage marketing channels, including LinkedIn, email, website, and other relevant digital platforms Establish marketing priorities, performance metrics, and processes that support sustainable growth Qualifications 3+ years of experience as a Marketing Lead. EdTech background strongly preferred. Strong understanding of the creative agency market, ideally from working within agencies or marketing products and services to them Proven B2B marketing experience, particularly in demand generation, positioning, and go-to-market execution Demonstrated ability to connect marketing efforts to qualified leads and revenue Excellent storytelling, writing, and creative campaign development skills Experience in early-stage startups or building marketing programs with limited resources Comfortable working hands-on across strategy, content, campaigns, and analytics Strong written and verbal English communication skills (C1 or above) Familiarity with AI tools, creative technology, or content production is a plus Experience in learning and development or educational technology is a plus Additional Information About SaaS Talent SaaS Talent is more than just a recruiting company. We're your hiring, business development and growth partner with 20+ years of experience in SaaS and Hi-Tech that helps you scale and transform your business. We've worked with 100+ companies and helped them achieve their goals. From streamlining sales, marketing, and operations to hiring ideal talent and getting funding, if you're struggling to grow, we're an ideal choice. Reach out to us at www.saas-talent.com to learn more about how we can help you . Standard message and data rates may apply, and messaging frequency varies. Text HELP for help and STOP to cancel. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Australia URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/ Paid Media Coordinator Are you someone who loves building relationships, spotting new opportunities, and bringing great ideas to life? We're looking for a Paid Media Coordinator to help grow Zanda's reach and connect more health professionals with the tools they need to run successful practices. In this hands-on role, you'll manage our advertising, sponsorship, and association partnerships across international markets. From discovering new opportunities to promote Zanda and negotiating great deals to coordinating the deliverables and measuring their impact, you'll play an important part in how we grow. You'll work within our Marketing team while having the autonomy to make things happen. What You’ll Be Doing Build and own relationships with associations, publishers, media partners, agencies, and vendors across our key international markets. Identify and pursue new opportunities for advertising, sponsorships, and partnerships that increase Zanda's brand awareness and reach. Evaluate and negotiate advertising opportunities, securing competitive rates, valuable placements, and partnerships that deliver results. Coordinate campaigns from start to finish, working with internal teams and external partners to keep creative assets, approvals, tracking, and deadlines on track. Manage Programmatic Advertising across channels such as Paid Social and Display, and support opportunities in Paid Search and emerging advertising platforms. Manage campaign operations, including advertising calendars, budgets, pipelines, and vendor coordination. Track and evaluate performance, using campaign data and insights to identify what's working, recommend improvements, and maximize the value of our advertising investments. What You’ll Bring to the Team 2-3+ years of relevant experience in marketing, media, partnerships, sponsorships, or campaign management. Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external partners, vendors, agencies, or stakeholders. Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to explore opportunities, discuss terms, and secure mutually beneficial outcomes. Experience coordinating campaigns or partnerships end-to-end, balancing multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently. A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to evaluate results and make practical recommendations, alongside experience supporting creative briefs, advertising copy, or landing-page improvements. Bonus Points If You Have: Experience working with professional associations, publishers, sponsorships, or media partnerships across international markets. Familiarity with Paid Social, Display, Paid Search, or emerging advertising channels. Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or project management platforms. An understanding of marketing metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, attribution, or UTM tracking. Experience in SaaS, HealthTech, or using AI and automation tools to improve marketing workflows. Who You Are A natural relationship builder. You enjoy connecting with people, creating genuine partnerships, and aren't afraid to negotiate or ask for a better deal. Proactive and resourceful. You spot opportunities, take initiative, and find ways to move things forward without waiting to be asked. Organized and detail-oriented. You can juggle multiple moving pieces while keeping track of the small details that make a big difference. Someone who takes ownership. You're comfortable making decisions, following through on commitments, and being accountable for outcomes. Adaptable and collaborative. You enjoy working with different people, navigating changing priorities and company direction, and finding solutions along the way. Why You’ll Love Working With Us ✅ Work from Anywhere We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together. ✅ Flexibility & Autonomy We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class. ✅ Generous Paid Time Off Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work. ✅ High Trust, Results Driven We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies - just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference. ✅ Growth & Innovation You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next. ✅ Inspiring Teammates You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win. ✅ Meaningful Impact Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives. ✅ Competitive Pay We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do. About Zanda Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started. Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable. To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments. At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day: Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development. Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers. Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Teamwork: We win together - celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs. Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy . This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference - we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zanda-health-marketing-coordinator-paid-media

items.summary: About Coalfire Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U
items.description: About Coalfire Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world. But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do. We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference. Position Summary Coalfire is seeking a hands-on Business Development Manager (BDM) to build and lead the operating program that turns demand signals into qualified sales conversations. This is a builder-owner role: the Manager designs the BDR operating system, sets priorities and capacity, establishes consistent routing and handoff practices, coaches BDR team, and reports on execution and outcomes. The Manager will take the lead in building out an initial BDR team who will execute the prioritized inbound and outbound motions. The BDM is accountable for making the program workable and measurable. What You’ll Do Build the BDR Operating Program Translate Sales priorities and available demand into a sequenced coverage plan across BDR motions and green-space prospecting. Set and maintain lead definitions, prioritization rules, routing, response expectations, escalation paths, qualification criteria, disposition practices, and seller handoff standards with Sales leadership and Sales Operations. Build practical playbooks, outreach cadences, messaging guidance, qualification prompts, and workflows that enable consistent execution across inbound and outbound motions. Establish a manageable operating rhythm for lead review, backlog management, handoffs, coaching, and cross-functional coordination. Partner with Sales Operations and Marketing to align approved tools, campaigns, events, CRM workflows, and reporting with the program’s needs. Document processes and decisions so the model can be evaluated, improved, and scaled if approved. Lead and Coach the BDR team Provide regular coaching on prospect research, outreach quality, discovery, qualification, dispositions, follow-up, and seller handoffs. Review calls, messages, CRM records, and handoff quality as appropriate; use feedback to improve performance and playbooks. Set clear expectations, support skill development, and address execution barriers promptly. Use BDR workload and outcome data to make realistic capacity decisions and prevent an overextended, all-motions-at-full-volume plan. Stay close enough to the work to build, test, and improve the system, while keeping the BDRs as the primary owner of daily lead execution. Manage Priorities, Capacity, and Cross-Functional Handoffs Prioritize work across inbound response and follow-up, nurture, customer cross-sell, win-back, RFP and buyer signals, marketing campaigns, events, and green-space outbound. Review incoming demand and available capacity; adjust sequencing, coverage, or workload with Sales leadership when demand exceeds the team’s ability to follow up consistently. Coordinate with Account Executives and account owners on routing, ownership, meeting acceptance, and feedback after handoff. Partner with Marketing on campaign and event follow-up and with Sales Operations on data, routing, tooling, and reporting. Clarify ownership boundaries: the BDR owns response, follow-up, qualification, disposition, and handoff; sellers own downstream opportunity creation and progression, pipeline development, and close. Establish Reporting and Validate Program Performance Create clear reporting for speed to first touch, response-expectation attainment, coverage by motion, qualification and disposition, seller acceptance, meetings held, workload, and data quality. Establish baseline measures and agree numeric success thresholds with Sales leadership before a pilot or launch is evaluated. Own the launch workplan and lead the 30-, 60-, and 90-day milestone reviews. Distinguish BDR-controllable execution measures from seller-shared downstream outcomes such as opportunity progression, pipeline, and Closed Won. Provide regular, concise updates on execution, capacity, risks, and areas for improvement; recommend whether to adjust, continue, or scale the program based on evidence. Avoid treating projected conversion lift, revenue, or payback as established until validated by results. What You’ll Bring 3+ years of relevant experience in business development, sales development, BDR/SDR operations, inside sales, or a related B2B sales function. Demonstrated experience building, improving, or scaling a sales-development motion, workflow, or team. Experience building a BDR program, playbooks, routing practices, service expectations, reporting, or capacity plans. Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM and sales engagement or prospect research tools. Some experience with Linkedin Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or similar tools. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Builder mindset: able to create practical processes and playbooks where the operating model is still developing. Strong organization, prioritization, analytical thinking, and follow-through. Ability to coach and develop a small team while maintaining a hands-on understanding of day-to-day execution. Clear communication and sound judgment across Sales, Marketing, Sales Operations, and account teams. Ability to translate business priorities into workable lead-routing, qualification, and handoff practices. Comfort using data to identify bottlenecks, manage workload, and improve a developing program without overstating what the data proves. Adaptability and resilience in a changing, early-stage operating environment. Bonus Points Experience coaching, mentoring, or leading the work of others; formal people-management experience is preferred. Background in cybersecurity, compliance, professional services, technology consulting, or a related market; compliance experience is a plus. Familiarity with Salesforce and sales engagement, prospecting, nurture, or marketing automation tools. $71,000 - $119,000 a year The salary range listed is a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role based on national salary averages. The actual salary offer to the successful candidate will be based on job-related education, geographic location, training, licensure and certifications and other factors. You may also be eligible to participate in annual incentive, commission, and/or recognition programs. #LI-HW1 #LI-Remote Why You’ll Want to Join Us At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively – whether you’re at home or an office. Regardless of location, you’ll experience a company that prioritizes connection and wellbeing and be part of a team where people care about each other and our communities. You’ll have opportunities to join employee resource groups, participate in in-person and virtual events, and more. And you’ll enjoy competitive perks and benefits to support you and your family, like paid parental leave, flexible time off, certification and training reimbursement, digital mental health and wellbeing support membership, and comprehensive insurance options. At Coalfire, equal opportunity and pay equity is integral to the way we do business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Coalfire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact our Human Resources team at [email protected]. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.summary: At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market. What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Cu
items.description: At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market. What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture. Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform. Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small. Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together! Anaplan is seeking a Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team in Germany —a group of expert consultants who are passionate about delivering real, measurable value through Anaplan’s cutting-edge planning platform. As a key member of our Professional Services team, you won’t just be implementing solutions, you’ll shape the future of enterprise planning for our most strategic customers. This team partners closely with stakeholders across Finance, Supply Chain, and Sales Performance Management to solve complex business challenges with smart, scalable solutions. From the very first engagement, you’ll have the opportunity to lead design, delivery, and strategic advisory work that drives transformation at the enterprise level. As we drive financial transformation, you will be a key player in architecting the future direction of decision excellence in enterprise grade companies across Germany. You will influence and drive a companies planning direction and play a pivotal role in delivering the outcomes the CFO, CIO and CEO need to take their business to the next level. We’re known for collaboration, deep expertise, and ability to unlock the full potential of Anaplan’s powerful connected planning platform. You’ll work with Anaplan’s industry-leading Hyperblock™ technology that delivers real-time data capabilities, and best in class planning and modelling capabilities. Grow your own skills while helping customers outpace disruption and outperform the competition—by planning smarter, faster, and more effectively. Your Role As an Architect, you are responsible for the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in some of our most important strategic accounts. Serve as the Architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions. design ownership across engagements, acting as design authority towards customers and partners, and solution review and quality assurance. Work with customer teams to transform and optimise business process through the Anaplan Platform. Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models. Support scoping, estimations and customer presentations as part of a solution sales process. Assist with knowledge management, mentoring and enablement across the Professional Services Teams. Your Qualifications We’re looking for smart, consultative professionals who love solving problems, building relationships, and pushing boundaries. We want you to bring your vision, experience, and passion to our team – helping our customers to out-predict, out-plan and outperform their competitors. 3+ years of experience implementing planning or EPM solutions in a customer-facing context (consulting, Professional Services or partner). Hands-on modeling in a multidimensional planning tool. Anaplan is ideal, but experience with TM1, OneStream, Pigment, Board, Jedox or similar is a valid basis. Solid understanding of planning processes in finance (FP&A), supply chain (e.g. S&OP, demand and supply planning), sales or workforce planning Experience running workshops, gathering requirements, presenting solution design. German (C1 or higher) and fluent business English. Willingness to travel within DACH. Ability to work remote and independently. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. Anaplan does not: Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence. Privacy & AI Notice Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Montreal, Quebec, Canada URL: https://www.sweatpantsagency.com/ Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. That is the whole job. Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business. So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face. At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero. You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end. Here is what "end to end" actually means. You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result. You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme. You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number. You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output. If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast. If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading. Requirements What the job looks like Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month. Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working. Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people. Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing. Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target. Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule. Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery. Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why. Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team. Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt. You are a fit if You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search. You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have. You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard. You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you. Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too. You are not a fit if "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed. You want to be told what to do this week. You need a ticketing system to know what matters. You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question. Benefits Why this role is exciting This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency. You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale. You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident. You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweat-pants-agency-ppc-marketing-specialist-remote

The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including e
items.description: About AlphaSense: AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us. About the Role We’re seeking a Staff Security Technical Program Manager to support our Security & IT leadership team from a program management standpoint. You’ll own delivery of multi-workstream programs across three of our biggest challenges: AI product and enterprise security; security operations and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC); and Secure IT. You’ll coordinate scope, owners, vendors, and timelines across Security & IT, Engineering, Product, People Ops, and Legal. Security and IT leaders stay focused on technical decisions while you keep programs moving, make status visible, and turn recurring security program work into repeatable, well-run processes. This is a hands-on program role for someone who brings structure to ambiguity and helps the team run programs more consistently. This role must be based in the United States or Canada. Who You Are 8+ years in security or IT program management, with a track record of owning multi-workstream programs end-to-end, planning a quarter ahead, and operating autonomously against a plan you build with stakeholders. Hands-on experience delivering complex, cross-team security programs, such as audits and certifications, third-party risk, incident response readiness, vulnerability management, identity and access, or AI security and governance. Proven ability to bring order to ambiguity: you sequence work to de-risk, hold owners accountable, and drive programs to green without hand-holding. Strong program management skills across concurrent programs; experience with Linear, Jira, Notion, or equivalent. Comfortable with Scrum, Kanban, and waterfall; adapts the method to complex programs and coaches teams on cadence. Proven ability to drive resolution of complex cross-team risks and dependencies, and to align leads and partners across Security, Engineering, Product, and IT without direct authority. Owns and standardizes simple, repeatable processes, templates, and playbooks across the team, and drives adoption to improve program delivery visibility and consistency. Communicates clearly with Security and IT leaders, engineers, and business stakeholders; tailors updates to the audience, drives decisions in the room, and raises risks early so there are no surprises. Experience defining and tracking program OKRs/KPIs and building dashboards and executive-ready summaries that tie metrics to business goals. Designs repeatable AI-assisted processes (such as skills and templates) that speed up planning, status reporting, and documentation for the team. Strong grasp of security fundamentals (risk management, identity and access, vulnerability and incident management, cloud and application security, and data protection), enough to plan and de-risk programs and anticipate domain risk across AI product and enterprise security, security operations and GRC, and Secure IT, and to know who to pull in for depth. Fosters a documentation culture and mentors teammates across the team. Preferred Qualifications Experience on a security team, supporting areas such as AI security, vendor risk, incident response, or GRC and audit programs (for example SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, or ISO 42001) Experience in a technology organization with AI / LLM exposure, or in a global, multi-site environment with vendor and procurement programs. What You’ll Do Drive Program Delivery: Own complex, multi-workstream programs end-to-end, from scope and plan through close-out, managing scope and risk in support of Security & IT leadership. Examples include audits and certifications, vendor risk programs, incident response readiness, and AI security initiatives. Support Security Domains: Partner with domain leads to run programs across AI product and enterprise security; security operations and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC); and Secure IT, such as audit and certification readiness, vendor risk follow-through, and incident and resilience planning. Enable Security & IT Teams: Handle coordination, tracking, and follow-through so security and IT engineers and managers can focus on technical work, not chasing status. Manage Dependencies: Drive resolution of complex cross-team dependencies and risks, and hold owners accountable to the program timeline, escalating risks early. Build Repeatable Process: Standardize intake, prioritization, and delivery practices for security and IT work in Linear and Jira so work is visible and consistent, drive adoption across the team, and mentor teammates on them. Report Progress: Define and track KPIs/OKRs tied to business goals; prepare dashboards and executive summaries for Security and IT leadership. Collaborate: Partner across Security & IT, Engineering, Product, People Ops, Legal, vendors, and TPM peers to deliver programs and drive alignment across teams without direct authority. Apply AI Leverage: Design repeatable AI-assisted workflows, such as skills and templates, using approved tools, and share them so the team can adopt them. Continuous Improvement: Finding friction or risk in existing process and making small, repeatable fixes so the employee experience gets better and operating cost and risk go down over time. For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below. You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program. Base Compensation Range $178,250—$200,000 USD AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination. In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works. Recruiting Scams and Fraud We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note: AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training. All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address. If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page. If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.
