items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: CA - San Francisco HQ; CA-Remote Employee Applicant Privacy Notice Who we are: Shape a brighter financial future with us. Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world. The role: SoFi is seeking an energetic, organized, and resourceful Direct Mail Marketing Manager for a one-year contract to manage the end-to-end direct mail creative process for the SoFi Credit Card product, from strategy and planning through creative development, stakeholder review, approval, production, and tracking. This role will also analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize future direct mail strategies and creative. At SoFi, you’ll become part of a new kind of finance company whose ambition is to help our members achieve financial independence and reach their goals. We aim to be at the center of our members’ financial lives and help every member get their money right. We created student loan refinancing, addressing the biggest financial challenge of a new generation through a modern approach to lending and personal finance. Next, we expanded our products and services across loans, investing, and cash management. SoFi has achieved significant growth, with ambitious plans ahead, but to continue this growth, we need great talent. And that starts with you. What you’ll do: This role owns four core areas of responsibility: 1. Creative Strategy & Planning Lead end-to-end creative strategy and execution for Credit Card direct mail campaigns, partnering with Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to align initiatives with business goals, priorities, and growth objectives. Lead quarterly creative planning with the creative agency, using audience insights, customer behavior, performance data, and test-and-learn principles to develop strategic recommendations for the Product Marketing Manager. Lead upfront data and audience planning with DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science and agency team defining targeting, segmentation, personalization, measurement requirements, and data inputs that inform the creative strategy, testing plan, and campaign brief. Own the creative roadmap and partner with the creative agency to develop compelling messaging, visual storytelling, offers, personalization, branding, and calls to action. 2. Campaign & Production Management Serve as the day-to-day campaign lead and primary liaison among Product Marketing Manager, the creative and data strategy agency, DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science, other internal stakeholders, and print vendors. Serve as the lead DM representative in Credit Card business unit meetings, Marketing Data Science handoff meetings, and other recurring meetings. Prepare slides as needed, capture key decisions and action items, and distribute notes to appropriate stakeholders. Translate approved strategies into actionable campaign plans, creative briefs, testing plans, and production requirements. Manage monthly direct mail tests and creative variations, ensuring audience definitions, segmentation, data requirements, personalization, and creative variants are aligned and executable. Own campaign timelines and the shared production calendar, including data due dates, creative milestones, review rounds, release dates, print dates, and drop dates. Manage assets, versioning, production samples, dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time. Maintain the monthly campaign matrix, including audience targeting, creative variations, testing plans, data requirements, and other campaign details. Partner with Marketing Data Science to update campaign matrices and verify that targeting and personalization information is accurate before each drop. Lead weekly status meetings with Product Marketing Managers, including agenda development, stakeholder alignment, and action-item follow-up. 3. Compliance, Quality & Operations Lead the Compliance and Legal review process for direct mail materials, partnering with Product Marketing and the creative agency to ensure executions meet regulatory, disclosure, brand, and business requirements. Manage creative review and quality control across messaging, data, personalization, offers, URLs, disclosures, and final production files. Serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring every campaign is accurate, compliant, data-aligned, approved, and production-ready. Manage campaign production and postage costs, partnering with the DM billing team to keep campaigns within budget. 4. Performance, Insights & Competitive Intelligence Partner with Marketing Data Science, analytics, and the creative agency to evaluate campaign and creative test results against product and business goals. Translate audience, performance, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform creative recommendations, messaging, offers, personalization, segmentation, and future test strategies. Lead weekly Product Marketing Manager performance updates and monthly reporting, presenting results and optimization recommendations to Product Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders. Apply campaign learnings to improve future direct mail initiatives and inform the creative roadmap. Build and maintain a competitive direct mail library, monitoring competitor activity, creative trends, offers, formats, personalization, and audience strategies. Share monthly competitive and performance insights with the broader Marketing organization to inform future campaign and product marketing strategy. What you’ll need: Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives. Experience managing high-volume direct mail, CRM, lifecycle, or integrated marketing creative execution, ideally within financial services, credit cards, banking, or another highly regulated industry. Strong project and production management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative versions, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously. Highly proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar, Tableau, Snowflake; comfortable building and maintaining detailed trackers and production workflows. Strong understanding of creative development, production, version control, review/approval processes, and vendor management. Experience working directly with Legal, Compliance, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Data, and external production vendors. Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership, particularly when managing personalized credit card communications where small errors can have significant downstream impact. Comfortable working in a test-and-learn environment, using campaign performance data to inform future creative decisions. Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to keep senior stakeholders informed while driving day-to-day execution. Financial services or credit card marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance reviews, disclosures, and credit-related communications. Compensation and Benefits The base pay range for this role is listed below. Final base pay offer will be determined based on individual factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, and location. To view all of our comprehensive and competitive benefits, visit our Benefits at SoFi page! SoFi provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, and conditions related to breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable state or federal law. The Company hires the best qualified candidate for the job, without regard to protected characteristics. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. New York applicants: Notice of Employee Rights SoFi is committed to an inclusive culture. As part of this commitment, SoFi offers reasonable accommodations to candidates with physical or mental disabilities. If you need accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, please let your recruiter know or email accommodations@sofi.com. We are unable to accommodate remote work from Hawaii, Alaska or Puerto Rico at this time. Internal Employees If you are a current employee, do not apply here - please navigate to our Internal Job Board in Greenhouse to apply to our open roles. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sofi-direct-mail-marketing-manager-credit-card-contract

items.description: About Figure We’re Figure (Nasdaq: FIGR), and we’re building the future of capital markets with blockchain and AI. We make lending faster and cheaper for everyone by automating the origination process and using blockchain as the source of truth for loan ownership and connection to our capital marketplace. It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business: Lending: HELOCs, cash-out refinance, DSCR loans, and crypto-backed loans for homeowners, investors, and small businesses. Through Kiavi, a Figure company, we also finance real estate investors with bridge, fix-and-flip, rental, and new construction loans. Markets: On Figure Markets, people can lend and earn with Prime and $YLDS, an SEC-registered, interest-bearing security that settles like cash. OPEN is our blockchain infrastructure for issuing, distributing, and trading equities. Partnerships: Banks, credit unions, fintechs, home improvement companies, and other lenders and brokers originate loans on our platform. DART records loan ownership on blockchain, and Figure Connect connects originators with institutional loan buyers. See all of our products on figure.com. Here’s where we are today: $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform 382K+ households served 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s $23B+ funded for real estate investors through Kiavi since 2013 Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000) If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you. About the Role We’re looking for an Underwriting Manager, Construction to join our growing team! As Underwriting Manager, Construction, you’ll serve as the operational bridge across cross-functional teams, driving alignment and execution throughout the loan lifecycle. You’ll manage a specialized team of Construction Underwriters and own the construction vertical across policy, process, and product success. You’ll be the primary escalation point for complex, stalled transactions, making decisive structural calls to unblock workflows. You’ll also structure deals upfront, oversee the pipeline, and drive efficiency and production strategy across alternative product lines, including Multifamily. With a deep understanding of secondary-market expectations, new-construction legal and insurance requirements, and multifamily cash flow analysis, you’ll make sure each project is sound at origination, monitored through completion, and ready for a successful loan sale. If you want to own construction lending end to end and are ready to unblock hard deals, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Serve as the primary escalation and resolution point for new construction and multifamily transactions, and as the cross-functional liaison who drives loan progression by resolving complex underwriting and operational requirements Run early deal reviews and structuring consultations with sales to evaluate complex or borderline transactions, structure complex loan scenarios in clear, executable terms beyond standard guidelines, and minimize downstream credit exception requests Oversee pipeline progression, drive workflow efficiencies, and manage production strategies for alternative product lines, including Multifamily and other specialized transaction types Apply rigorous cash flow analysis to multifamily projects, evaluating income, expenses, and stabilization assumptions to confirm each transaction is structured to perform as underwritten Monitor construction projects from origination through final draw, verify milestone requirements are met, and spot projects falling behind schedule or budget early, working with the borrower, sales, and servicing partners to address risks before they become losses Collaborate with Capital Markets on loan sale and diligence requests so construction files are complete, well documented, and aligned with investor and secondary-market expectations Partner with operations and technology teams to close automation gaps and drive the system support needed to optimize cross-functional workflows Contribute to credit policy for the construction vertical, partner with credit risk teams on policy rollouts, align credit guidelines and standard operating procedures, build a continuous feedback loop to resolve operational inconsistencies, and enforce intake guardrails so loan files hold all required documentation before credit review Keep current on jurisdiction-specific legal requirements for new construction and on insurance requirements such as builder’s risk coverage, and make sure credit policy and loan documentation reflect them in every market we serve Manage, coach, and mentor a team of specialized Underwriters, with regular feedback, performance evaluations, and strategic workload balancing, and protect our culture by keeping the environment open, communicative, and collaborative, with knowledge sharing and professional development What We Look For 7+ years of experience in a similar or closely related field 1+ years of experience in people management Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative business or finance discipline (such as Finance, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, or Business Analytics) Demonstrated experience applying quantitative analysis to support business decisions Solid understanding of secondary-market dynamics, including the loan sale process and the diligence standards investors apply to construction loans Familiarity with the geography-specific legal requirements that govern new construction Working knowledge of the nuances of insurance requirements for new construction projects Demonstrated ability to track projects from origination through draws and hold them to milestone requirements Proficiency in cash flow analysis for multifamily property projects Strong working knowledge of property valuation methods and appraisal types, with the ability to guide the valuation process and answer questions from underwriters, sales, risk, and external partners about valuation types, methodology, and how they apply to construction and multifamily transactions Proven ability to quickly master and work expertly in the tools the construction team uses Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude or Copilot, with an automation-first mindset Ability to troubleshoot workflow issues independently and translate between operational needs and technical solutions Experience with Tableau, JIRA, Trust Point, and Appraisal Works (preferred) Experience with Salesforce (preferred) Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures. Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes. Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team. Salary Base Compensation Range: $101,600 - $152,400/year 25% annual bonus, paid quarterly Company equity in the form of RSUs This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above. Benefits Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits Employer-paid life and disability insurance 10 observed holidays and PTO plan Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave Continuing education reimbursement Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice. Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. #LI-JR1 #LI-Remote

items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Location: Seoul About the Role The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle. The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes. In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in your assigned territory. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As a Senior Territory Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency. Responsibilities Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets. Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation. Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners. Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads. Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals. Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes. Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing). Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with at least 8+ years of relevant work experience. Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms. Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets. Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies. Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows. Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills. Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite). Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn. Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment. Ability to travel as required. Cultural fluency for assigned markets; language proficiency where required. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

items.summary: Job Title: E-commerce Data & Catalog Specialist Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems.
items.description: Job Title: E-commerce Data & Catalog Specialist Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Key Responsibilities: Manage, structure, and curate large-scale e-commerce product catalogs, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across platforms. Develop, implement, and refine product taxonomy frameworks to simulate real-world e-commerce classifications and browsing experiences. Normalize and map product data sourced from diverse databases, applying best practices in structured dataset management. Create and model realistic shopping scenarios that reflect authentic consumer behavior and decision-making processes. Collaborate with AI development teams to define data needs and optimize catalog structures for scalable AI training. Ensure strict adherence to data quality, integrity, and normalization standards within SQL and NoSQL environments. Document workflows, taxonomies, and metadata structures with clear, concise written communication. Required Skills and Qualifications: Demonstrated experience in product catalog management and e-commerce merchandising operations. Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL database concepts, schema design, and product data modeling. Strong command of product taxonomy development, categorization, and data normalization methods. Deep understanding of structured dataset management, including large and complex e-commerce catalogs. items.summary: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters:
items.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. About the Role Smartsheet’s organic search program is a critical driver of awareness and demand — and we’re investing to grow it. Our SEO/AEO & Demand Strategy team is responsible for how Smartsheet shows up across traditional search and AI-powered answer engines, and we’re looking for an SEO/AEO Strategist to help us do both smarter and faster. This role is for someone who can own SEO and AEO end-to-end — from pulling the data and doing the research, to developing the strategy, to actually writing the content. We’re not looking for someone who hands a brief to a writer and moves on. We want the person who does the keyword research, builds the content framework, and then writes the page. You should be genuinely excited about where search is heading. The rise of generative AI and answer engine optimization has changed the game, and we want someone who’s been paying attention and has a point of view about what it means for how we work. You’ll partner closely with colleagues in Web Strategy, Web UX Design, and DXO, and you’ll be a key connector for our Content and Campaigns teams. What You’ll Do Performance Analysis & Reporting Monitor, analyze, and interpret SEO and AEO performance metrics — rankings, impressions, click-through rates, AI citation rates — and translate trends into clear, actionable recommendations Build and maintain regular reporting cadences that help the team track progress and make faster decisions Keyword & Prompt Research Conduct ongoing keyword research for traditional search, with strong attention to competitive landscape and search intent Identify and map the prompts and questions most likely to surface in AI-powered answer engines; develop strategies to improve Smartsheet’s visibility and citation rate in those responses Content Strategy & Development Translate research into content frameworks, topic clusters, and page strategies — and then execute on them directly, writing optimized web copy, landing page content, FAQs, and supporting content Develop content briefs when work is handed off to other writers or agencies; maintain editorial standards that keep SEO and AEO requirements front and center Partner with Web Strategy on pillar page structure and content architecture to ensure organic strategy is reflected in how the site is organized Write and optimize content for both traditional search and AI answer engines — with a clear understanding of how structure, tone, and formatting affect visibility in each On-Page Optimization & Technical Awareness Partner with DXO and Web Strategy to ensure pages are structured and optimized for both search crawlers and AI answer engines — metadata, schema markup, E-E-A-T signals, heading hierarchy, internal linking Conduct regular content audits to identify underperforming pages, content gaps, and consolidation or refresh opportunities — and prioritize what gets actioned Maintain working familiarity with technical SEO fundamentals — Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexation, page speed — and know when to escalate issues to the dev team vs. self-serve Where applicable, make direct edits in Drupal to implement optimizations without requiring a developer handoff Competitive & Trend Monitoring Track changes in the search landscape, algorithm updates, and shifts in AI search behavior Surface relevant findings proactively and help the team adapt quickly when the environment changes What You Bring 8+ years of experience spanning SEO, content strategy, and content production — with meaningful time spent in both search optimization and actual writing; B2B or SaaS experience strongly preferred Strong working knowledge of SEO fundamentals: on-page optimization, technical SEO concepts, keyword research, content strategy, and how link signals work Hands-on experience with core SEO and analytics tools — Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, GA4, and Looker Studio; familiarity with AI visibility and AEO tracking platforms (Profound, Otterly.ai, or similar) Solid understanding of AEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) principles — including E-E-A-T signals, entity recognition, and structured data — and how LLMs and AI-powered search are reshaping content visibility and citation Ability to turn data into direction: you can look at a performance report and know what it’s telling you to do next Strong copywriting skills — you write clean, optimized web content and can move fluidly between long-form page copy, concise FAQs, and structured content formats; a portfolio or writing samples will be part of the review process Collaborative by nature: you’ll be working across time zones with US-based colleagues and regional marketing partners Bonus if you have: Direct experience with Drupal or another enterprise CMS — ability to make page edits without a handoff is a meaningful plus Experience optimizing content for AI-generated answers (AEO, AI Overviews, Perplexity, etc.) and/or hands-on experience with AI visibility tracking tools such as Profound, Peec, or similar platforms Familiarity with schema markup and structured data implementation Familiarity with off-page SEO tactics — link building, digital PR, and authority-building strategies Experience in a global, multilingual web environment Why This Team The SEO/AEO & Demand Strategy function at Smartsheet is growing, and there’s genuine whitespace here. You’ll be working on a program that’s evolving in real time as search itself changes — which means real opportunities to shape how we approach this work, not just execute a fixed playbook. If you’re someone who wants to be in the room where organic strategy gets made, this is the seat. Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Get to Know Us: At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together. Equal Opportunity Employer: Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

items.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
items.summary: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant. Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content. Originally posted on Himalayas

By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time v
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote Why join us Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek. Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career. Marketing at Brex Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. Our team spans Revenue, Product, and Brand Marketing, and works closely with nearly every function at Brex. We move fast, experiment often, and think deeply about customer behavior. If you want your creativity to drive growth and shape perception, this is the place. What You'll Do As a Field Marketing Coordinator, Upmarket, you'll play an important role in helping Brex scale regional marketing programs that drive pipeline generation, accelerate opportunities, and strengthen relationships with senior finance, accounting, and procurement leaders across Enterprise and Mid-Market organizations. Reporting directly to the Field Marketing Lead, Upmarket, you'll support a diverse portfolio of revenue-driving initiatives, including executive experiences, regional events, account-based marketing (ABM), and digital campaigns. You'll take ownership of day-to-day program execution and operational coordination, working closely with Sales, Marketing, and cross-functional partners to bring programs to life. Your work will help expand our regional presence, improve program efficiency, and ensure consistent Sales activation before, during, and after each program. The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, builds strong relationships with Sales, and understands how thoughtful execution drives business growth. You’ll bring attention to detail, creative problem-solving skills, and the ability to balance multiple projects and competing priorities while delivering high-quality work. Where you'll work This role will be fully remote and based in the United States. Responsibilities Own day-to-day planning and execution for Upmarket field marketing programs, including executive experiences, regional dinners, sporting events, and digital activations. Coordinate event logistics, including venue sourcing, vendor management, catering, gifting, shipping, registration, attendee communications, budgets, and onsite execution. Develop and maintain event timelines, registration pages, attendee trackers, run-of-show documents, and internal event briefs. Partner with AEs, SDRs, and Sales leadership to support account targeting, prospect outreach, attendee engagement, and pre- and post-event follow-up. Execute smaller, repeatable regional programs and sales-led experiences that strengthen customer relationships, support multi-threading, and accelerate pipeline. Support integrated digital marketing campaigns across email and paid media, coordinating audience lists, creative assets, landing pages, campaign launches, and performance tracking. Coordinate ABM and direct-mail campaigns, including prospect targeting, vendor management, gifting, fulfillment, and delivery tracking. Maintain the Field Marketing events calendar, campaign documentation, and performance reporting across Salesforce, registration platforms, and marketing automation tools, tracking meetings generated, qualified pipeline, and pipeline influence. Requirements 2+ years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, demand generation, project management or a related role. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally. Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day execution with minimal supervision. Ability to adapt to changing priorities, solve problems quickly, and maintain high-quality execution under tight deadlines. Ability to travel up to 40% of the time to support regional events and onsite execution. What Success Looks Like Seamless program execution: Deliver high-quality field events and integrated campaigns on time, within budget, and with minimal operational friction. Increased program capacity and efficiency: Expand the team's ability to execute more regional and digital programs through repeatable processes, automation, and streamlined workflows. Stronger Sales activation: Improve the consistency and timeliness of prospect outreach, attendee engagement, and post-event follow-up. Measurable business impact: Support programs that generate qualified pipeline, strengthen customer relationships, and accelerate revenue opportunities. Compensation The expected salary range for this role is $73,600 - $105,800. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package. Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/brex-field-marketing-coordinator-upmarket

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote URL: http://wevote.us Help Shape How Millions of Voters Engage with Reliable Civic Information WeVote is a nonpartisan civic technology nonprofit dedicated to increasing voter participation through innovative digital tools and trusted voter education resources. As a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee, WeVote empowers voters with the information they need to make informed decisions and participate confidently in democracy. We are seeking a strategic and innovative Director of Content Strategy to lead the development and execution of WeVote's content vision across digital channels. This volunteer leadership role is ideal for an experienced content strategist, communications leader, digital marketer, or media professional who is passionate about civic engagement and audience growth. As Director of Content Strategy, you will define how WeVote communicates with voters, volunteers, supporters, and stakeholders through impactful content initiatives. You will oversee content planning, messaging strategy, editorial priorities, audience engagement efforts, and cross-functional collaboration to expand WeVote's reach and influence. What You'll Do Develop Content Strategy Create and lead a comprehensive content strategy that aligns with WeVote's mission, organizational goals, audience needs, and voter engagement objectives. Drive Audience Growth & Engagement Identify opportunities to expand audience reach, increase engagement, and strengthen relationships with voters, volunteers, donors, and supporters through strategic content initiatives. Lead Content Planning Oversee content roadmaps, editorial calendars, and campaign planning across blogs, newsletters, voter education resources, thought leadership content, and digital communications. Shape Organizational Messaging Develop messaging frameworks and content guidelines that ensure consistency across all channels while reinforcing WeVote's nonpartisan mission and brand voice. Collaborate Across Teams Partner with leaders across Product, Political Data, Communications, Marketing, Partnerships, and Volunteer Recruitment to identify content opportunities and align messaging efforts. Analyze Content Performance Monitor content effectiveness, audience behavior, engagement metrics, and communication trends to continuously improve content strategy and impact. Lead Content Contributors Provide strategic guidance and leadership to volunteer writers, editors, researchers, content creators, and communications team members. Support Thought Leadership Initiatives Help position WeVote as a trusted leader in civic technology, voter education, and democratic participation through compelling storytelling and content innovation. What We're Looking For Content Strategy Experience 3+ years of experience in content strategy, communications, digital marketing, content leadership, audience development, media, publishing, or related fields. Strategic Thinking Demonstrated ability to create and execute content strategies that drive awareness, engagement, audience growth, and organizational impact. Audience & Engagement Expertise Experience understanding audience needs, developing content journeys, and optimizing content performance across digital channels. Strong Communication Skills Exceptional writing, editing, messaging, and storytelling abilities with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, accessible content. Data-Informed Decision Making Comfortable using content analytics, engagement insights, and performance metrics to guide strategic decisions. Cross-Functional Leadership Experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders and managing projects across multiple teams and initiatives. Mission Alignment Passion for democracy, civic engagement, voter education, and leveraging content to create meaningful social impact. Self-Starter Mentality Ability to thrive in a remote, volunteer-driven environment while independently driving strategic initiatives forward. Why Join WeVote? Help shape how millions of voters access and engage with trusted civic information. Lead content strategy for a nationally recognized civic technology nonprofit. Build executive-level experience in digital strategy, communications, and audience development. Collaborate with mission-driven professionals in technology, media, civic engagement, and nonprofit leadership. Make a measurable impact on voter participation and democratic engagement. Position Details Location: Remote (U.S.-based volunteers preferred) Time Commitment: Approximately 5–10 hours per week Compensation: Volunteer Position * Fraud and phishing warning * Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you!! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wevote-director-of-content-strategy

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The police are one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. Police officers spend a large proportion of their time on data work and comparatively little on the actual investigation. We want to turn that around. With our new police solution, Metropolis, we help police authorities connect and make sense of their data, so that officers can focus on what matters most: solving cases and keeping people safe . To address this, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Police . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows police work from the inside: how investigations really run, where time is lost in data work, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships with police authorities at federal and state level and position Celonis as a long-term partner for their digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of police work into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships with police authorities at federal and state level, e.g. Bundespolizei, Bundeskriminalamt (BKA), Landeskriminalämter (LKA), Landespolizeien and the responsible Interior Ministries . Engage with decision-makers from police leadership, investigation units, IT and digitalization departments, and procurement Translate investigators' daily challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases for Celonis and Metropolis, with measurable impact (e.g. time saved per case, faster case processing). Bring the voice of the police into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate public procurement and tender processes (e.g. VgV, VSVgV, UVgO, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and public IT service providers. Represent Celonis at public sector events, conferences and police-specific forums. The qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the German police (federal or state level), ideally in a leadership role and/or in an area close to investigations, criminal analysis, IT, digitalization or organizational development. A solid network within the police landscape and a deep understanding of how police authorities and Interior Ministries are organized, how decisions are made and how budgets are planned. First-hand understanding of the data challenges in police work, e.g. case management, evidence and data analysis, and cross-agency information sharing. A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role. Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way. Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new. Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and very good English. Familiarity with public procurement processes is a strong plus. Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset. Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins #LI-SS6 What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celonis-account-executive-public-sector-germany-police-polizei

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote United Kingdom BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio. Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself. The Role The Paid Media Manager will own paid media strategy and execution for BeyondTrust's International markets (EMEA, UKI, and APJ), driving pipeline through demand creation and capture campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Targeted Display, and Video (CTV and YouTube). You will manage the international paid budget, serve as the primary partner to our global digital agency, and work closely with regional Field Marketing and ABM teams to build integrated, locally relevant campaigns. You will be accountable for pipeline contribution and cost efficiency across all International markets, and you will ensure our paid programs are compliant with GDPR and built on consent-driven measurement. What You’ll Do Plan, launch, and optimize always-on paid media campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Targeted Display, and Video, including ad copy, creative briefs, campaign setup, and performance reporting Manage and allocate the annual international paid media budget to maximize ROI and pipeline impact across regions Lead local-language campaign execution, with German and French as primary languages, working with the agency and regional teams to ensure messaging is accurate and culturally relevant Ensure paid campaigns comply with GDPR and related privacy regulations, and implement consent-driven targeting and measurement approaches that preserve reporting accuracy Serve as the day-to-day lead for our global digital agency, which manages the global BeyondTrust account with a dedicated focus on the International markets, holding them accountable for performance, scope, and spend pacing Partner with Field Marketing in EMEA, UKI, and APJ on regional campaign strategy, and recommend optimizations for each geography and strategic campaign Work with the Integrated Campaigns and ABM teams to build and deploy targeted campaigns at scale, using intent data from 6sense and ZoomInfo Align paid media with organic efforts in partnership with the SEO and Social Media teams Run A/B and multivariate tests on ad copy, creative, and landing pages to meet performance targets Report regularly to stakeholders on performance, communicating insights and recommendations Track digital marketing trends and recommend new channels and tactics to reach our target buyers What You’ll Bring Ideally 4+ years of B2B digital marketing experience, including managing paid campaigns across multiple regions or markets Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, LinkedIn, and YouTube, plus display and video platforms In-depth knowledge of paid search management, including keyword research and optimization Working knowledge of GDPR and consent-driven measurement for paid campaigns, and how privacy regulation shapes targeting and attribution Solid understanding of ABM advertising strategies and intent-data tools (we use 6sense and ZoomInfo) Experience managing external agency relationships Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, diagnose performance problems, and make data-driven decisions Experience running A/B and multivariate tests Experience with ad reporting and CRM tools such as Salesforce and Power BI Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns across regions while keeping setup and execution accurate Excellent written and verbal communication skills Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience Better Together Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected. We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together. About Us BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders. BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners. Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com . #LI-KP1 #LI-Remote To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/beyondtrust-paid-media-manager
