items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Yerevan, Remote, Armenia URL: http://capslock.global CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions. At CapsLock , people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success. ﻿Role overview Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly. You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow. If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process. Responsibilities Task & Pipeline Management Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system). Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed Quality Control Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals Reporting & Documentation Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards Process Improvement & AI Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes Creative Collaboration Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time Must-Have Skills Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content Technical Skills 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher Soft Skills Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines Clear, professional communicator Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas What we offer Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact. Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet. Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more. Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience. Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program. Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/capslock-creative-marketing-project-coordinator-1

items.title: Enterprise Performance Lead
items.summary: Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier. The Actuarial Strategic Operations team serves as the operational and financial nerve center for Clover's Medicare Advantage business. Embedded within the Actuarial and Finance organization, the team combines deep business expertise with advanced analytics and AI to integrate financial, operational, and actuarial insights, monitor enterprise performance, evaluate strategic initiatives, and deliver timely recommendations that improve affordability, member outcomes, and financial performance. At Clover, AI is part of how we work. We expect leaders to thoughtfully incorporate tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and emerging enterprise AI technologies into their daily workflows to improve analytical quality, accelerate execution, and enable better decisions. The Enterprise Performance Lead serves as a strategic business partner within Clover's Actuarial Strategic Operations, owning financial and operational partnership for one or more areas across the Medicare Advantage business. This role partners across Finance, Actuarial, Clinical, Revenue, Pharmacy, and Operations to align operational execution with financial performance, ensuring enterprise initiatives deliver expected outcomes. As a member of the Actuarial Strategic Operations team, you will leverage automation and AI-enabled ways of working to enhance analytical workflows, improve reporting, accelerate insight generation, and strengthen executive decision support. The Enterprise Performance Lead reports to the Director of Actuarial Strategic Operations and serves as a strategic business partner within Clover's MA Plan Actuarial Strategic Operations team. Successful candidates are curious, analytical, and collaborative problem-solvers who enjoy working across multiple business functions to evaluate strategic initiatives, identify opportunities, As an Enterprise Performance Lead, you will: Develop and continuously evolve performance monitoring frameworks using leading and lagging indicators, dashboards, and KPIs to evaluate initiative performance, proactively identify execution risks, and recommend actions that enable faster, data-driven decision making. Translate operational performance into financial insights by leveraging AI alongside traditional financial analysis to evaluate initiative performance, identify variances, surface emerging risks and opportunities, and communicate actionable recommendations that inform business decisions and financial objectives.Â Â Lead financial and operational workstreams for priority initiatives from evaluation through implementation and outcome monitoring, partnering with business owners to identify risks, track performance against expectations, and recommend corrective actions when results deviate from plan. Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Actuarial, Medical Economics, Clinical Operations, Revenue, Pharmacy, Product, and Analytics to align operational execution with business and financial priorities, integrate cross-functional insights, and advise financial planning and strategic decision making. Lead executive reporting and business reviews with oversight from the Director by developing dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting that leverage automation and AI to improve analytical efficiency, reporting quality, and leadership visibility into performance.Â Drive operational excellence by standardizing reporting processes, improving data quality, identifying opportunities for automation, and adopting AI-enabled solutions that reduce manual effort, accelerate analysis, and improve scalability across assigned business areas. Success in this role looks like: In your first 90 days, you will:Â Build strong cross-functional partnerships with business leaders to understand operational priorities and establish yourself as a trusted business partner.Â Â Learn the financial drivers, operational workflows, and strategic initiatives within your assigned area(s) of responsibility. Develop effective dashboards, KPIs, and AI-enabled reporting that provide timely visibility into initiative performance, financial impact, and execution progress. After 6 months, you will:Â Deliver regular business reviews that communicate initiative performance, financial impact, emerging risks, and opportunities using clear, data-driven insights. Implement proactive performance monitoring that leverages leading indicators and AI-assisted analysis to identify execution gaps and recommend timely actions. Become a trusted business partner by providing actionable financial and operational insights that influence decision making across your assigned business areas. Future success in this role includes: Influence business decisions and priorities within assigned areas by delivering data-driven financial and operational insights that improve enterprise decision making. Drive reporting and analytical excellence by expanding automation, improving data quality, and increasing the efficiency and scalability of reporting processes. Help establish the Actuarial Strategic Operations as a trusted source of performance insights, execution monitoring, and financial intelligence. You will love this role if: You enjoy solving complex and ambiguous business challenges through data-driven analysis, AI-enabled exploration, and structured problem solving. You are energized by influencing business decisions through financial insights, rapid experimentation, and actionable recommendations powered by modern analytical and AI tools. You thrive in highly collaborative environments, partnering across cross-functional teams to solve complex cross functional challenges and adopt new ways of working.Â You enjoy building new capabilities, AI-enabled workflows, and scalable reporting processes that improve organizational performance and create lasting business value. You should get in touch if: You have experience: 4-6 years of experience in healthcare medical economics, population health, analytics, actuarial, consulting, strategy, or operations, with demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives and delivering data-driven business insights. Experience applying AI to improve analytical workflows, operational efficiency, or business decision-making is strongly preferred.Â You have industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of Medicare Advantage, managed care, payer economics or value-based healthcare preferred.Â You have technical Skills: Experience using Python or R, business intelligence platforms, and modern AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, improve reporting, and enhance decision support is strongly preferred.Â You have an AI Mindset: Demonstrates curiosity, sound judgment, and a continuous improvement mindset in applying AI to solve business problems, automate routine work, improve analytical quality, accelerate execution, and enhance decision-making while maintaining appropriate governance, data integrity, and analytical rigor. Â You have communication: Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into actionable business insights and recommendations for business leaders.Â You have a demonstrated ability to build trusted cross-functional partnerships, influence stakeholders and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Â You have preferred Domain Experience: Experience supporting one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:Â â Clinical Care Delivery, Care Management, or Value-Based Care â Utilization Management, Payment Integrity, FWA Investigations, or Provider Operations â Risk Adjustment, Revenue Operations, Medicare Stars, Growth, or Member Experience â Pharmacy Operations, Medicare Part D Benefits Overview :Â Â Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.Â Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most. We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare. From Cloverâs inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of oneâs identity. All of our employeeâs points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicantâs education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $111,000 â $144,000 USD Please mention the word **ALTRUISTIC** and tag ROS4xNjkuMTk4LjIwMg== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#ROS4xNjkuMTk4LjIwMg==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Canada URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/4dyzGH7uUuNnNDur5PLBgE/jobs-at-wealth-without-wallstreet Now Hiring: A Sales Manager Who Wants To Think Like A Founder (And Get Paid Like One). If you need a "supportive culture" and a 90-day onboarding plan before you can pick up the phone, get on a live call to sell and lead from the front, then close this tab. You're not our people. Still here? Keep reading. We're Wealth Without Wall Street. We teach business owners, professionals and families how to build real wealth without handing their future to some stranger in a Manhattan high-rise. Our mission is to help over 1 million people create financial freedom. The equation for us is simple: the day your passive income exceeds your monthly expenses, that is the day you're financially free and that is what we help people achieve. The movement is growing faster than we can handle. That's why we are writing this. We are looking for ONE Sales Manager. But not the kind you're picturing. No dashboard-hiders. No "Q3 alignment" types. We want a player-coach. A killer with a headset who can master our system in weeks, close deals from the front lines, and set a pace that makes the rest of the team stand up straighter. Then you get the keys. You hire your team. You train them in your image. You build something that didn't exist before you got here. That's not a department. That's a legacy. This is not a coast job. Not a "circle back Tuesday" job. Not a place where mediocrity gets another quarter to figure itself out. If your pulse picked up while reading this, prove it. Don't send us a resume that reads like a LinkedIn obituary. Tell us what you've closed. Tell us what you've built. Tell us why you're the one. What You’ll Do: Phase 1 – Master the Machine Learn our scripts, CRM, and booking process Sharpen your sales skills and start closing deals Audit our current system and identify areas for improvement Work with our existing team to increase their output Phase 2 – Scale the Team Continue to recruit insurance agents and closers for our coaching offer Continue to recruit and add to your SDR Team Lead 1:1 coaching, daily huddles, live sales reviews, and performance tracking Build sales culture and help the team hit their stride fast Work with leadership on onboarding, training systems, and KPIs Phase 3 – Own the Department Drive the department’s revenue, recruiting, and team performance Collaborate with execs to scale campaigns and comp plans Develop internal leaders and create strong bench strength under you You're the kind of person who doesn’t wait for direction — you take it and run. You’ll crush this role if you: Have 3–5+ years in sales, including 1–2 years leading high-performing teams Have managed a sales team of 20+ people You are tech savvy You understand and are proficient with pipeline management Have built, hired, or scaled a sales team before Are a strong closer with deep understanding of sales psychology Know how to motivate, coach, and hold others accountable to results Want ownership, not micromanagement Have a track record of driving numbers into the green and scaling sales systems Are obsessed with growth — both personally and professionally Want to build something long-term with real legacy potential KPI Ownership: 400+ Appointments Set / Month 250+ Appointments Held / Month 100+ Applications / Month $1M+ in Funded Policies / Month Reps onboarded and fully ramped within 30 days We believe in building something bigger than ourselves — and taking care of the people who help us do it. What You’ll Get: Compensation: Compensation: Base of $5,000 - $10,000+ Per Month to Start Based on Experience, Past Results & Tenure Up to $12,000/month in bonus potential for Funded Policies 3% revenue share on Lab division which is our coaching business Leadership Opportunity: Real decision-making power — not just managing, but building Direct collaboration with founders and execs A voice in compensation, culture, and long-term strategy Team & Culture: Join a mission-driven team that cares deeply about freedom A high-performance culture built on accountability and growth Systems and support to help you win Long-Term Potential: Opportunity to build your own division within the company Create systems, culture, and success that outlast you Mentorship from 7- and 8-figure business builders To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wealth-without-wallstreet-sales-manager

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://www.catonetworks.com Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. Cato Networks is seeking a NOC Engineer to join the team. In this critical role, you will be monitoring, supporting, and providing advanced troubleshooting of a large complex data network infrastructure by using network monitoring and management tools. You will work closely with teams from our business areas, network engineering, and management as a team representative on major incident bridges. This is a remote position based in the Philippines. Key Responsibilities Own and manage the uptime, stability, and overall functionality of the company’s production systems. This includes troubleshooting and resolving system and network issues end-to-end. Monitor and respond to NetOps alerts during working hours, and review/follow up on alerts triggered outside business hours as required. Continuously track and analyze system performance to identify risks, bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and opportunities for optimization. Proactively mitigate outages and system malfunctions to prevent customer impact. When necessary, prepare clear and prioritized escalations to the relevant Development teams. Coordinate with third-party service providers (e.g., carriers, SMS providers, IX providers, and other vendors) to resolve network and system-related issues. Provide advanced (higher-tier) technical support to internal Customer Support teams (T1–T3). Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and alerting mechanisms to ensure system visibility and operational awareness. Serve as a technical focal point for Customer Support and Field Engineering teams by understanding business use cases and translating them into operational requirements. Contribute to building, improving, and expanding NetOps ownership, processes, documentation, and operational best practices. Role Scope The role is primarily driven by automated system alerts requiring investigation, troubleshooting, and escalation when necessary. The role also involves handling customer-impacting issues escalated by the Customer Support organization. In addition to reactive tasks, the position includes ongoing projects and operational initiatives to be managed during working hours. Required Skills & Experience Strong experience in network architecture, cloud architecture, and security architecture. Deep knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, firewalls, proxy servers, and related technologies. Strong ability to analyze system and application logs to identify root causes of issues. Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex network and system incidents. Experience working in a Cloud or SaaS technology environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document findings and communicate with cross-functional teams. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple concurrent projects and incidents simultaneously. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cato-networks-noc-engineer

Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets manageme
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, U.S. Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com . The Role This role leads the North America MidMarket team and is accountable for new logo acquisition and expansion revenue across the segment. The expectations are high: a team that generates its own pipeline, deals that are qualified with discipline, forecasts that hold, and Account Executives who improve every quarter. This is not an oversight role. The leader in this seat works alongside their team, sets the standard for outbound execution, and uses data to drive performance. It is built for a first-line leader who has already delivered results and wants to operate at the pace and scale of a fast-growing company. Responsibilities Deal leadership Engage directly in the team's most important opportunities: discovery, executive alignment, mutual close plans, pricing and commercial structure, procurement, and security review. Set the standard for value-based selling: quantifying the customer's business pain, building the business case, and tying Bitwarden to measurable risk reduction and operational outcomes. Diagnose and unblock stalled deals, and use them to raise the skill level of the entire team. Outbound pipeline generation Build and mature a repeatable cold outbound motion with AEs and partnered SDRs: territory and account prioritization, ICP and persona targeting, multi-threaded sequencing, and messaging that resonates with IT, security, and finance buyers. Set activity and pipeline-generation standards, inspect them weekly, and hold every AE accountable for self-sourced pipeline. Align with Marketing and Sales Development on programs that produce qualified pipeline at a predictable rate. MEDDPICC and value-based execution Run MEDDPICC as the team's operating system across qualification, deal reviews, forecast calls, and win/loss analysis, with value-based selling defining how the team earns and proves each element. Inspect every material opportunity for quantified Metrics, a validated Economic Buyer, a tested Champion, clear Decision Criteria and Process, a mapped Paper Process, and an honest read on Competition. Deliver an accurate weekly forecast built on deal evidence and maintain CRM data the business can rely on. Data-driven coaching Own the team's KPIs (pipeline generation, coverage, stage conversion, win rate, cycle length, average deal size, and activity-to-outcome ratios) and act on what they show. Identify where each AE is losing ground (pipeline creation, qualification, progression, or close) and build targeted coaching plans to close the gap. Run a disciplined operating cadence: weekly 1:1s, pipeline and deal reviews, forecast calls, and call reviews. Team building Recruit, hire, onboard, and ramp high-caliber Account Executives, and develop them toward promotion. Build a culture of accountability, competitiveness, and continuous improvement. Work across Sales Operations, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Channel, and Marketing to deliver revenue as one team. Requirements 3–5 years of first-line sales leadership, ideally leading AEs selling security SaaS (identity, access, credential, endpoint, or adjacent categories). A proven, documented track record of quota attainment as a leader, and as an individual contributor before that. Deep working fluency in MEDDPICC and value-based selling, applied together to qualify, inspect, forecast, and coach. A track record of building and maturing a cold outbound pipeline, with the ability to explain exactly how it was done and what it produced. Strong analytical skills, including fluency with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and spreadsheets, and a record of using KPIs to direct coaching and improve AE performance. A hands-on approach to leadership, with direct, regular involvement in live deals. Strong intellect, a fast learning curve, and the drive to perform in a high-growth environment with demanding targets. Experience selling to IT, security, and executive buyers in organizations of roughly250–2,500 employees. A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations. Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $145,000- $160,000, plus uncapped variable compensation. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-mid-market-sales-leader

items.summary: Headquarters: Poland - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people,
items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Poland - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Backend Reliability (BRE) team is the backbone of our backend infrastructure and the guardian of our uptime. Our mission is to achieve and sustain 99.99% availability while building the tools, components, and safety nets that the entire engineering organization relies on. As a Senior / Staff Backend Engineer on this team, you won’t just close tickets - you’ll architect core reliability solutions that shape how Wrike scales, performs, and recovers from failure. Your Impact: Design, build, and maintain critical reliability components such as HTTP rate limiters, internal DB schema migration tools, circuit breakers, and distributed Redis-based caching. Troubleshoot complex production issues, optimize PostgreSQL usage, and ensure our distributed systems remain performant and stable under high load. Lead preliminary investigations during severe production incidents: identify likely root causes, assess impact, and propose mitigation options. The long-term fixes are then implemented by the owning team, based on your findings. Create scalable, reusable tools and frameworks that help other engineering teams build more resilient services. Leverage AI-powered tools and coding agents to accelerate development, analyze architectures, and automate repetitive or error-prone tasks. Influence reliability best practices across engineering by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs, and setting high technical standards. Your Qualifications: Strong expertise with Java/JVM, building scalable, high-performance backend systems; open to leveraging other languages when appropriate. Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including high availability, CAP theorem, and fault tolerance. Deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and key–value / non-relational storages (Redis). Practical experience with containerization and cloud-native environments, including Docker and Kubernetes. Hands-on experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ or Kafka. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, using critical thinking to question assumptions and validate your own decisions. Strong written and spoken English skills suitable for collaborating in an international engineering environment. Standout Qualities: Background in infrastructure engineering or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), including infrastructure-as-code practices. Experience leading technical initiatives, driving cross-team projects, and mentoring other engineers while remaining an individual contributor. Familiarity with observability and monitoring stacks (e.g., Graylog, Zabbix, Grafana) and/or data analytics tools such as BigQuery. A strong interest in how complex systems fail and a track record of designing them to recover gracefully. Team Dynamics: You will join the Backend Reliability (BRE) team, a small, highly specialized, senior group focused solely on Wrike’s reliability. The team operates as an internal “reliability task force,” partnering closely with product and platform engineering teams across the company. You’ll collaborate with other senior engineers who value autonomy, deep technical discussions, and rigorous engineering practices. The culture is ownership-driven: you are trusted to manage your time, make architectural decisions, and drive initiatives to completion. Our Work Style: The BRE team works on core backend and infrastructure services that support millions of users. We operate in a collaborative environment that values clear communication, thoughtful design, and fast feedback loops. Tech focus areas include: Java/JVM-based services, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ/Kafka, and observability/monitoring tools. We encourage the use of modern AI-based tooling and coding agents as part of daily development and troubleshooting workflows. Work is organized with an emphasis on impact and reliability goals rather than ticket volume, giving you room for deep work and long-term improvements. Hybrid work mode (Prague, Czech Republic / Nicosia, Cyprus), with flexibility to balance focused individual work and collaborative sessions. What’s next? Interview with a Recruiter Technical interview System Design Interview Cultural interview Your recruitment buddy will be Aleksandar Chernev , Senior Technical Recruiter. #LI-AC1 Who Is Wrike and Our Culture We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow. Hybrid work mode Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations. While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection. Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-staff-software-engineer-1

Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-staff-software-engineer

items.description: Einleitung Es ist momentan keine für dich passende Stelle ausgeschrieben? Wir sind immer auf der Suche nach motivierten und kreativen Köpfen, die Ihren Beruf mit Leidenschaft machen. Das trifft auf dich zu? Dann lass uns gerne eine Initiativbewerbung zukommen! ​​​​ Deine Aufgaben Dich erwarten spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, bei denen Verantwortung und Teamgeist wichtig sind. Du unterstützt dein Team in den Bereichen Softwareentwicklung, Business Intelligence, Marketing, Controlling oder im Customer Support. Du übernimmst die eigenverantwortliche Bearbeitung verschiedener Themenstellungen. Du arbeitest aktiv in unterschiedlichen Projekten mit. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in einem relevanten Fachbereich oder eine vergleichbare Berufsausbildung. Du findest dich in einem dieser Bereiche wieder: Grafikdesign/Frontend, Backend, Business Intelligence, Marketing, Controlling oder Customer Support und hast entsprechend fundierte Fachkenntnisse. Du bist offen für neue Technologien die uns weiterbringen. Du bist selber Gamer:in oder weißt was Gamer:innen wollen und fühlst dich in diesem Umfeld wohl. Du besitzt Eigeninitiative und arbeitest ergebnisorientiert. Du bist kommunikativ, ein(e) Teamplayer(in) und hast Spaß an dem was du tust. Du verfügst über gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch. Deine Benefits Gaming im Herzen: Wir bieten kostenlose Nitrado Game Server für Gamer und eine einladende Community für alle, die sich wohlfühlen möchten, selbst wenn du kein/e Gamer:in bist. Entdecke, wie Nitrado mehr ist als nur Gaming - eine offene Community für Technologie und Kreativität. Vertrauensarbeitszeit: Passe deine Arbeitszeiten an deine persönlichen Bedürfnisse an, um eine bessere Work-Life-Balance zu erreichen. Remote Work: Unsere agilen Teams arbeiten Hand in Hand von ihrem bevorzugten Standort aus zusammen, sei es in unseren modernen Büros in Karlsruhe oder Berlin oder vollständig remote. Work from Abroad: Erweitere deinen Arbeitsbereich über die nationalen Grenzen hinaus mit unserer Remote-Work-Lösung aus dem Ausland. Wir ermöglichen es dir, zeitweise von deinem bevorzugten internationalen Standort aus zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig mit deinem Team in Kontakt zu bleiben. Mentale Gesundheit: Wir unterstützen deine mentale Gesundheit durch unseren jährlichen Mental Health Day. Physische Gesundheit: Unsere Büroinfrastruktur bietet modernste Arbeitsplätze mit ergonomischem Design, um deine Gesundheit und Produktivität zu fördern, während du auf dem Arbeitsweg mit deinem JobRad fit bleibst. Zusätzlich erhältst du einen großzügigen Zuschuss zu ergonomischen Home Office Möbeln, um auch von zu Hause aus optimal arbeiten zu können. Weiterbildung: Nutze Fort- und Weiterbildungen, um Deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln und auf dem neuesten Stand zu bleiben. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir unterstützen Deine finanzielle Sicherheit für die Zukunft mit einem attraktiven Zuschuss. Arbeitsumfeld: Bei uns erlebst du ein respektvolles und freundliches Arbeitsumfeld, geprägt von Transparenz und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur. Urlaub und bezahlte Freizeit: Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub und bezahlten Sonderurlaub zu besonderen Anlässen. Internationale Zusammenarbeit: Als internationales Unternehmen überwinden wir erfolgreich Zeitzonen und Sprachbarrieren und bieten dir eine internationale Arbeitsatmosphäre. Soziale Aktivitäten: Stärke Dein Engagement und den Teamzusammenhalt durch Team-Building-Events, der Teilnahme an Sportevents und sozialen Aktivitäten. Langjährige Stabilität: Mit über zwei Jahrzehnten Erfahrung sind wir ein verlässlicher Arbeitgeber für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Get together: Wer arbeitet, kann auch feiern - Wir kommen regelmäßig für unsere Firmenfeiern zusammen und stärken unsere Teambindung. Firmenkultur und Werte: Du wirst Teil einer positiven Unternehmenskultur, die Werte wie Diversität und Inklusion lebt. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.summary: EverHelp is a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo.
items.description: EverHelp is a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo. The project launched in 2021, and last year we experienced a yearly growth rate of +82%. Since February 2022, we've managed to preserve all our workplaces and, most importantly, we continue to strengthen our team while maintaining an employee satisfaction rate of over 90%. In 2026, EverHelp received 9 international workplace and employer awards. The company ranked #1 in the Top 30 Inspiring Workplaces in Europe, was named the #1 employer among European companies with 500–4,999 employees, and earned Best-in-Class recognition across 6 categories: Culture & Purpose, Leadership, Inclusion & Belonging, Wellbeing, Employee Voice, and Employee Experience. EverHelp was also named one of the 28 Best Places to Work by Business Intelligence Group — a global award recognizing companies with strong workplace cultures and outstanding employee experience. Our statement: We’re against war and unjustified aggression, We evacuated all the teammates and their families from the frontline, helped them find a new place to live and provided financial support, We provided the team with charging stations, We continue to work together for the future of Ukraine. As EverHelp continues expanding its portfolio of international customer support projects, we are looking for a Customer Support Representative (Hospitality) to join our team. In this role, you will support guests of a fast-growing hospitality project, ensuring every interaction reflects genuine care, professionalism, and a guest-first mindset. You'll help resolve booking-related inquiries, reservation issues, and other service requests while creating an outstanding customer experience across multiple communication channels. Your future responsibilities include: Providing support to guests via phone calls, email, live chat, WhatsApp, and online booking platform messages; Assisting guests with booking inquiries, reservation updates, property access, and other accommodation-related requests; Delivering exceptional customer service with a genuine hospitality mindset and a "guest-first" approach; Resolving customer inquiries efficiently while maintaining a warm, professional, and empathetic communication style; Escalating critical cases, including refund requests, legal matters, or sensitive guest complaints, to the appropriate internal teams; Accurately documenting customer interactions and case details in internal systems; Collaborating closely with teammates to ensure a seamless guest experience across all communication channels; Following internal quality standards while balancing efficiency with exceptional service. Needed experience & skills: 1–3 years of experience in Customer Support, Hospitality, or another customer-facing role; German language proficiency (B2+) and English language proficiency (B2+); Experience communicating with customers across multiple channels, including calls and written communication; Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions independently; Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset; Ability to remain calm, professional, and solution-oriented in challenging situations; High adaptability and willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-changing environment; Strong multitasking skills while maintaining high service quality; Positive attitude, resilience, and genuine enthusiasm for teamwork. Work with EverHelp is about: 20+ vacation days and 10 paid sick leaves; Ability to work fully remotely; A professional team of specialists, ready to share their expertise, along with internal communities and team activities, fosters continuous learning and development both within the team and on an individual level; Opportunity for a career growth. 32% of our teammates obtained a new role during their first year of work in our company. 86% of our Team Leads have been our Customer Support Agents in the past. Submit your resume and join our team! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Verticals (AI Native)
items.summary: Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.life360.com About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver rep
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.life360.com About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set. We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale. About the Job Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products. You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets. You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket. Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side. In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $103,500 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 149,500 to 177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. What You’ll Do Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands. Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality. Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt. Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement. Participate in on-call rotation and incident response. Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards. Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own. Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands. What We’re Looking For 4+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services. 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs. Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and mobile client development (Swift for iOS and/or Kotlin for Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed. Hands-on experience with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context window management, and MCP/function calling. A track record of using AI tooling to multiply your own output — not just as autocomplete, but as a development partner. A strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix, and you follow through past "it works on my machine" to "it works for the member, in production, at scale." Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well with product, design, and platform engineers. Excitement for defining what it means to be AI-Native — you're not waiting for the playbook, you want to write it. Empathy for the humans behind the product — an aging parent trying to stay independent, or a family member trying to help from afar. Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field, or equivalent experience. Nice-to-Have Experience with IoT, telematics, or embedded/hardware-adjacent systems. Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other high-throughput streaming platforms. Background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DataDog). AI-Native Expectations We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice: Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete but as a development partner. Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship. Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team. Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed. Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees. 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees. Paid parental leave. Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being. Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns. Learning & Development programs. Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment. Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers. AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams Life360 Values Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Belonging Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway. #LI-Remote ____________________________________________________________________________ To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/life360-senior-software-engineer-verticals-ai-native

items.title: Content Creator - YouTube
items.summary: Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered. Job Overview Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media. About us Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them. We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone. We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world. What you'll do Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way. Write video scripts and outlines. Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos. Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor. What we're looking for Native-level written and spoken English Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work Ability to take feedback and continuously improve Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada Nice to have Previous experience creating educational video content Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos Working at Metics Media At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work. At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos. Compensation Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada) Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed. Benefits 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays 10 paid sick days per year Medical, dental, and vision coverage A 401(k) with employer contributions (US) How to apply Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

items.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
items.summary: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. Prescription Fulfillment : Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. Refills & Continued Use : Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. Program Renewal & Updates : Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. What We’re Looking For: High school diploma or GED required Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus) Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment Success Factors for Working from Home Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. Ergonomics : A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. Reliable Internet Connection : Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace : A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. Tech-Savvy : Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. Self-motivation & Independence : Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. Communication Skills : Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. Adaptability : Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. Compensation & Perks Hourly Pay : $16.50 per hour Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. Comprehensive Benefits : Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. Cell Phone Benefits : $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). Generous Referral Program : Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. Comprehensive Training : Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. Career Growth : Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. Work-from-Home Convenience : Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. Inclusive Culture : We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. What Success Looks Like: Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance Why Join Us? Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors Competitive compensation and benefits package A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture Ready to Make an Impact? Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

items.title: FirstPrinciples Research Fellow
items.summary: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe.
items.description: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries. We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3). As part of this effort, we are launching a Research Fellowship Program for advanced AI and physics researchers. Fellows will work directly with the FirstPrinciples Research and Engineering teams to design, test, and implement state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and applications that will be integrated into the core AI Physicist system. This is not a paper-only fellowship and your work will go straight into production, helping shape how scientific research is performed. What You will DoAs a Research Fellow, you will own a well-scoped research direction that contributes directly to the AI Physicist's ability to reason about physics. Core Objectives: Improve Theo’s ability to produce scientifically sound, high-quality outputs in 2026; Introduce new ideas, methods, and approaches that meaningfully shift system performance; Bring deep domain expertise (PhD+ level) in one or more targeted research areas. Research Areas & Responsibilities Fundamental Model Research : Research, design, and test novel model architectures that combine academic literature, NLP, symbolic reasoning, and structured scientific workflows. Prototype and build embedding representations for physical concepts, mathematical objects, and logical structures, enabling models to reason over equations, abstractions, and scientific constraints rather than surface text alone. Investigate alternatives to transformer-based architectures and deliver concrete recommendations. Design and run targeted experiments to evaluate new architectural ideas, using empirical results to guide the development of next-generation model architectures. Develop reinforcement learning loops that enable models to run internal and independent thought experiment. Multimodal Data & Benchmarking : Design and automate scalable data ingestion pipelines that aggregate scientific literature, metadata, equations, and experimental data. Create custom benchmarks to measure physical understanding, mathematical reasoning, and failure modes in scientific reasoning and abstraction. Refine and release curated datasets and baselines once internal validation is complete. Training, Testing & Safety : Run and track model training jobs while managing compute usage and budget constraints. Design sandbox environments for controlled autonomous exploration. Build evaluation frameworks using visual and statistical tools to identify strengths and blind spots. Implement tests and guardrails that flag low-quality or unsafe outputs. Maintain internal issue tracking with clear failure modes and fixes. Collaboration & Technical Guidance : Work closely with engineers to ensure research is feasible and production-ready. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Present regular research updates tied to defined milestones. Who This Fellowship Is ForWe are looking for researchers who: Can operate independently and own a problem end-to-end. Are motivated by ambitious, long-horizon goals. Have strong builder instincts, not just theory. Value rigor, clarity, and intellectual honesty. Are comfortable engaging with exploratory, incomplete results. Typical profiles include: PhD or postdoctoral researchers in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Theoretical Physics, or a closely related field. Track record of research in either: model architectures, representation learning, or reasoning systems (CS/ML path); or mathematical, physical, or formal reasoning applied to fundamental problems (physics path). Demonstrated ability to translate abstract theory into testable computational systems. Comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries. Program Structure 6-12 month engagement with full-time or equivalent commitment Fully remote Fellows participate in projects and are expected to produce outputs (code, models, and other deliverables) Fixed stipend for the full term How to Express Interest:If this resonates, we welcome an expression of interest, including: Resume; Description of your research background; Primary areas of expertise; and Relevant recent work. Join us at FirstPrinciples and be a part of a transformative journey where science drives progress and unlocks the potential of humanity. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Lead Creative

You’ll guide a global team of top-tier creatives, combining strategic leadership with hands-on craft to deliver human-centered, high-impact work for leading brands worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of creativity and innovation, elevating creative quality while helping evolve our capabilities through the thoughtful use of AI tools. You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.
